GuKWmNBY5l.evidence: Toys4K, covering VAE reconstruction and artist-mesh generation under point-cloud and image conditioning, compared with MeshFlow.
GuKWmNBY5l.claimed_gains: In point-cloud generation the non-manifold edge ratio is zero versus 11.50% for MeshFlow, with inference taking about 15 seconds per mesh (abstract truncated).

WRilIg5UPY.one_liner: Initializes linear ViTs by copying pre-trained Softmax MLP weights and distilling attention outputs from the Softmax teacher.
WRilIg5UPY.problem: Linear ViTs need from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform Softmax ViTs, and it is unclear how to initialize them from pre-trained Softmax weights.
WRilIg5UPY.method: Copies MLP weights directly because they are operator-agnostic, and recovers the attention function by distillation with a proper loss design, since copying attention weights barely helps and is sometimes worse than random initialization.
WRilIg5UPY.key_idea: Transfer MLP weights by direct copy and recover the attention's function by distillation, because attention weights are operator-specific while MLP weights are operator-agnostic.
WRilIg5UPY.evidence: Comparisons of copying versus random initialization for attention and MLP weights in Softmax-to-linear ViT transfer (details truncated in the supplied abstract).
WRilIg5UPY.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract and TL;DR claim linear ViTs can match or even surpass Softmax ones.

IBXfuf1ODe.one_liner: Closed-loop post-training that turns policy rollout failures into targeted human recovery demonstrations for real-time combat agents.
IBXfuf1ODe.problem: Expert demonstrations are collected open loop and emphasize successful trajectories, so policy-induced failure states are underrepresented and shift as the policy evolves.
IBXfuf1ODe.method: A multimodal coach translates recurring rollout failures into recovery requests; the resulting demonstrations are stored in a recovery library and retrieved by failure mode during later supervised updates, while rollout feedback supports critic-free policy optimization and selective replay.
IBXfuf1ODe.key_idea: Use recurring policy failures as a curriculum that decides what humans demonstrate next, retrieving failure-specific recovery demonstrations during supervised updates.
IBXfuf1ODe.evidence: Seven Black Myth: Wukong bosses and two character configurations (results are cut off in the supplied abstract).

xubFwuQ3oM.one_liner: Training-free diffusion LM decoding combining confidence-verified global early exit with accelerated local token commitment.
xubFwuQ3oM.problem: The composability of adaptive sampling and global early exit in diffusion language models is unexplored, and a fixed progress threshold wastes compute on short answers or stops reasoning tasks prematurely.
xubFwuQ3oM.method: Confidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) ends generation using confidence and temporal agreement over the revision history, while Commit-Core-Then-Confirm (CCTC) extends confidence-threshold parallel decoding with a boundary-anchored core and one-step confirmation of deferred predictions.
xubFwuQ3oM.key_idea: Stop decoding when confidence and agreement across revisions both indicate stability, and commit tokens via a boundary-anchored core confirmed in one extra step.
xubFwuQ3oM.evidence: Decoding-trajectory analysis showing short answers stabilize early while reasoning outputs need more steps; experimental details are cut off in the supplied abstract.
xubFwuQ3oM.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the TL;DR says decoding steps are reduced while task performance is largely preserved.

cjupyCANnB.one_liner: Neural radar field with a measurement-formation renderer separating occupancy, reflectivity and radar artifacts, supervised with LiDAR.
cjupyCANnB.problem: Most radar novel view synthesis methods simplify measurement formation and model only scene responses, leaving radar-specific artifacts under-represented and limiting fidelity to real radar measurements.
cjupyCANnB.method: For points sampled along each radar beam, the field predicts scene occupancy, radar reflectivity and artifact contribution, which a differentiable renderer grounded in radar measurement formation combines into measurements. LiDAR measurements supervise a shared geometry field to disentangle geometry from artifacts.
cjupyCANnB.key_idea: Predict occupancy, reflectivity and artifact terms per beam point, combine them through a physics-based differentiable renderer, and anchor geometry with LiDAR.
cjupyCANnB.evidence: Extensive experiments reported as higher-fidelity radar synthesis than existing methods; datasets are not named in the abstract.

cb7jNXVfJX.one_liner: Web-based benchmark of 135 vision-intensive tasks across five professional applications testing temporal, graphical and 3D reasoning for agents.
cb7jNXVfJX.problem: Existing agent benchmarks use popular applications with simple tasks and a narrow set of capabilities, so modern agents saturate them.
cb7jNXVfJX.method: GauntletBench covers five applications (Video Editor, Workflow Builder, 3D Modeller, Flight Analyser, Circuit Designer) with 27 tasks each, using a modular pipeline of an environment for open- and closed-source agent frameworks, a controlled web application, a task suite and an automated evaluation engine.
cb7jNXVfJX.key_idea: Evaluate agents on less-covered professional web applications that require temporal perception, graphical understanding and 3D reasoning.
cb7jNXVfJX.evidence: Empirical evaluation of frontier agentic systems against human-level performance on the 135 tasks.
cb7jNXVfJX.claimed_gains: The best agent achieves only a 28.2% success rate on GauntletBench.

6oc16xM5Fb.one_liner: Data-free layer-wise merging of long-CoT and short models that allocates coefficients by CoT update strength and conflict.
6oc16xM5Fb.problem: Long-CoT models produce unnecessarily long responses to easy problems, and existing merging methods use uniform coefficients or auxiliary data and lack analysis of conflicts between long-CoT and short-model updates.
6oc16xM5Fb.method: BCL-Merge computes two data-free per-layer signals, the strength of the CoT update and its conflict with the short model's update, to select layers and assign merge coefficients under a given reasoning-strength budget. The authors state that under explicit assumptions the allocation optimizes an objective (cut off in the abstract).
6oc16xM5Fb.key_idea: Allocate per-layer merge coefficients by CoT update strength discounted by conflict with the short model's update, under a reasoning-strength budget.
6oc16xM5Fb.evidence: A theoretical optimality claim under explicit assumptions; empirical results are cut off in the supplied abstract.

CC4ksJJPIN.one_liner: Restores RL plasticity of over-trained SFT checkpoints via base-anchored model fusion and targeted neuron reset.
CC4ksJJPIN.problem: Checkpoints with excessive SFT show limited improvement during subsequent RL, which the authors attribute to lost plasticity, seen as over-confident token distributions and sharp parameter landscapes.
CC4ksJJPIN.method: Rejuvenation fuses the SFT model with the base model to reduce SFT-induced drift (base-anchored fusion) and resets targeted neurons to mitigate rigidity.
CC4ksJJPIN.key_idea: Pull SFT weights back toward the base model by anchored fusion and reset selected neurons to restore the model's ability to be reshaped by RL.
CC4ksJJPIN.evidence: Analysis of parameter changes, output spaces and RL optimization dynamics, and experiments on math reasoning and agentic tasks at different SFT stages.
CC4ksJJPIN.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports recovered RL performance from checkpoints at different SFT stages and a wider viable SFT-to-RL handoff window.

angFodM7lk.one_liner: Staged framework deciding from trajectories which exact structural law to impose, or refuse, using a per-step sign identity.
angFodM7lk.problem: The specification behind exact structure-preserving dynamics models (which law, which metric, which coordinates) is never tested, because a prediction loss cannot tell a correct specification from a wrong one.
angFodM7lk.method: A per-step identity reduces the structural question to the sign of one symmetric matrix and yields a library of five exact constructions under the Euclidean block metric. Three conditional stages then decide what the identity leaves open, separating a finite-trajectory statistical decision from a guarantee that holds at every parameter value.
angFodM7lk.key_idea: Reduce exact-constraint feasibility to the sign of one symmetric matrix per step, then enforce a constraint only on blocks where trajectory data support it.
angFodM7lk.evidence: Experiments on analytically labelled systems that isolate what each stage contributes.
angFodM7lk.claimed_gains: Discover recovers coordinates at median invariant R^2 of 0.73 to 0.86 against 0.10 to 0.22 for a comparison objective; refusing unsupported blocks costs 4% more out-of-family error than an oracle router, while enforcing every block costs 39%.

d09ROpuTpH.one_liner: Looped padded Transformer with per-position gold CoT-step supervision that closes the latent-versus-explicit CoT gap at 3B.
d09ROpuTpH.problem: Existing latent CoT methods underperform explicit CoT beyond 1B parameters, and the gap widens with scale.
d09ROpuTpH.method: LOTUS processes K latent blocks in parallel for R loop iterations in a looped padded Transformer, with a cross-entropy loss on each latent position's gold CoT-step token, similar to explicit CoT supervision.
d09ROpuTpH.key_idea: Supervise each latent position of a weight-shared looped Transformer with the gold CoT-step token, processing K latent blocks in parallel for R iterations.
d09ROpuTpH.evidence: Experiments at 3B scale on compact math expressions and natural-language reasoning, plus decoding post-loop latents through the base LM head to recover the gold reasoning steps.
d09ROpuTpH.claimed_gains: Bridges the gap to explicit CoT at the 3B scale while cutting thought-phase latency by 2.5x-6.9x.

KG93HHa9L5.one_liner: Self-supervised video pretraining distilling Sinkhorn optimal-transport patch assignments from a privileged teacher to a masked student.
KG93HHa9L5.problem: Raw frames give no explicit patch-to-patch alignment over time, and pretraining must derive correspondence supervision without optical flow, point tracks or correspondence annotations.
KG93HHa9L5.method: A privileged teacher uses information privilege plus Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport to produce globally constrained cross-frame patch assignments, which a restricted student predicts from masked inputs with row-wise Softmax. Only a standard encoder is kept after pretraining.
KG93HHa9L5.key_idea: Build cross-frame patch assignment targets with Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport in a privileged teacher, then have a masked student predict them with row-wise Softmax.
KG93HHa9L5.evidence: Three dense correspondence benchmarks and transfer experiments (abstract truncated).
KG93HHa9L5.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract claims the best overall performance among self-supervised pretrained encoders across three dense correspondence benchmarks.

dH6LRV4zgT.one_liner: Flow-matching model samples dynamically feasible robot trajectories conditioned on human motion for dexterous retargeting.
dH6LRV4zgT.problem: Inverse kinematics retargeting ignores dynamics, while RL and sampling-based MPC are sample-inefficient and hyperparameter-sensitive, and MPC solves each trajectory in isolation.
dH6LRV4zgT.method: GNR hypothesizes that feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, and uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories conditioned on human motion instead of solving a fresh optimization per demonstration.
dH6LRV4zgT.key_idea: Learn the low-dimensional manifold of dynamically feasible robot trajectories with flow matching and sample from it conditioned on human motion.
dH6LRV4zgT.evidence: Comparison against sampling-based MPC on dexterous retargeting (further details are cut off in the supplied abstract).
dH6LRV4zgT.claimed_gains: Outperforms MPC with only 8.5% of the samples MPC requires, with a success rate of 56.10% versus 28.13% for MPC.

3qGkXbEMLS.one_liner: Head-wise LoRA variant using input-dependent Householder transformations so each attention head adapts in its own subspace.
3qGkXbEMLS.problem: Standard LoRA makes all attention heads share one latent adaptation space even though pretrained heads play distinct roles, which limits expressiveness.
3qGkXbEMLS.method: HyRA generates an input-dependent Householder transformation for each head, giving the update DeltaW^h = B_h H_h(x) A with a shared low-rank A, head-specific B_h and no increase in LoRA rank.
3qGkXbEMLS.key_idea: Insert a head-specific, input-dependent Householder reflection between low-rank factors so each head modulates features along its own direction.
3qGkXbEMLS.evidence: Not stated in the supplied abstract, which is truncated before the experiments.

9A7crvlccl.one_liner: Constructs fixed-size latent KV blocks for agent communication in one forward pass, distilled from an autoregressive latent teacher.
9A7crvlccl.problem: Text communication between LLM agents repeats generation and re-encoding, and latent communication can still require a sequential latent trajectory to build each message.
9A7crvlccl.method: Thought Blocks map a compact continuation representation and compressed contextual KV memory to parallel latent positions, rendered into model-native KV continuation states in one frozen-backbone forward pass. The writer is trained by distilling continuation states from an autoregressive latent teacher whose trajectory is omitted at inference.
9A7crvlccl.key_idea: Compile the latent continuation state directly into fixed-size KV blocks in one non-autoregressive pass, trained to match states reached by an autoregressive latent teacher.
9A7crvlccl.evidence: Multiple LLM backbones on reasoning and question-answering tasks, compared with autoregressive latent communication and text-based multi-agent communication.
9A7crvlccl.claimed_gains: A 2.5 times average latency speedup over autoregressive latent communication while maintaining competitive accuracy.

gJSZEDEBBU.one_liner: Reweights VLA verifier training toward decision-critical states, identified by dispersion of sampled action representations.
gJSZEDEBBU.problem: Classification-based verifiers learn from trajectory outcomes but treat all visited states equally, although only a sparse set of states admits action choices that change downstream outcomes.
gJSZEDEBBU.method: DiVeR estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations and uses it to reweight verifier learning, without step-level annotations or additional environment interaction.
gJSZEDEBBU.key_idea: Measure state criticality by how spread out sampled action representations are, and weight verifier training toward high-dispersion states.
gJSZEDEBBU.evidence: LIBERO, RoboCasa and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot.
gJSZEDEBBU.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports consistently improved task success with negligible verifier inference overhead.

bA6HOzShFe.one_liner: Dataset and benchmark of 20,937 production-level generation tasks with truth-grounded verifiers, plus an agentic co-training baseline.
bA6HOzShFe.problem: Visual generators fabricate characters, symbols and facts they never learned, because they learn from fixed corpora while user requests are unbounded, evolving and long-tailed.
bA6HOzShFe.method: Builds SearchGen-20K, SearchGen-Corpus-1M and SearchGen-Bench with verifiers that check the requested content, then proposes a minimal baseline with a noise-resistant agentic protocol that co-adapts the generator and the search agent.
bA6HOzShFe.key_idea: Let an agent retrieve evidence for the generator under a noise-resistant protocol, and co-adapt generator and agent so search does not override the generator or go stale.
bA6HOzShFe.evidence: Comparison of open-weight generators with agent-powered frontier APIs on production-level requests.
bA6HOzShFe.claimed_gains: A gap of up to 35pp between open-weight generators and agent-powered frontier APIs on production-level requests.

sWUobHTEJq.one_liner: Executable benchmark of 140 cross-OS code migration tasks between Linux and Windows across five languages.
sWUobHTEJq.problem: Repository-level SWE benchmarks built from GitHub issues and pull requests give limited insight into migrating an implementation between operating systems while preserving behavior on both.
sWUobHTEJq.method: Identifies migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage from the same repository on both OSes, verifies platform-specific regions, organizes them into five migration scenarios, and builds tasks with target-platform tests and source-platform regression tests.
sWUobHTEJq.key_idea: Find cross-OS migration tasks from differences in execution coverage between Linux and Windows runs of the same repository.
sWUobHTEJq.evidence: 140 validated tasks from 111 repositories in C, C++, C#, Go and Rust; six models evaluated with SWE-agent, Claude Code, OpenHands and Win-agent.
sWUobHTEJq.claimed_gains: The best configurations achieve only 26.4% success on Linux-target tasks and 20.4% on Windows-target tasks while preserving correctness across both systems.

QHtneC4srX.one_liner: Benchmark of 3,244 questions testing persistent spatial memory across revisits to rooms in synthetic and real homes.
QHtneC4srX.problem: Existing evaluations leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit, although embodied agents must recognize revisited places, tell apart similar-looking rooms and update memory as environments change.
QHtneC4srX.method: ReSpaceBench has 590 scenes and 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking and downstream reasoning, using controlled walkthroughs with same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes.
QHtneC4srX.key_idea: Define visits by physical room entry and add same-type distractor rooms and cross-session object changes to test persistent place identity.
QHtneC4srX.evidence: Evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks, with a human annotator comparison and agent-trace analysis.
QHtneC4srX.claimed_gains: The strongest zero-shot model reaches 50.5% overall and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, against 90.1% for human annotators.

rcTBR9J06T.one_liner: Amplifies the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along a weak teacher's policy shift for weak-to-strong generalization.
rcTBR9J06T.problem: Conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the stronger student.
rcTBR9J06T.method: OPRD evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction, rescaling only verifier-supported updates so the stationary points of policy optimization are preserved.
rcTBR9J06T.key_idea: Rescale the verifier-based policy gradient along the teacher's policy-shift direction on student rollouts, so teacher guidance speeds learning without becoming the objective.
rcTBR9J06T.evidence: Successive model transfer, multi-teacher distillation and conventional strong-to-weak distillation, plus a style analysis of the resulting students.
rcTBR9J06T.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports higher performance with fewer student updates than existing RL and distillation approaches.

b46UkkoZIT.one_liner: Chooses retain, repair, delete or downweight per record using the post-trained tabular foundation model's own feedback.
b46UkkoZIT.problem: Fixing a detected error does not always help a post-trained tabular foundation model and action effects need not add, so data preparation should be judged by the trained model rather than by data correctness.
b46UkkoZIT.method: Flags errors from dependency violations and label checks, trains a predictor on self-injected errors without true values to choose each record's action, keeps a prepared table only if repeated short post-training beats the unchanged one, and reprioritizes records from the model's feedback.
b46UkkoZIT.key_idea: Accept data actions only when short post-training of the tabular model shows the prepared table beats the unchanged one, using model feedback to reprioritize records.
b46UkkoZIT.evidence: Six tables with injected errors over multiple data seeds against 14 baselines, 21 sensor time-series fault scenarios, and instruction tuning of Qwen2.5-1.5B, plus a proof that removing repair or fractional weights can strictly hurt under the same budget.
b46UkkoZIT.claimed_gains: Gains 7.0 accuracy points over unchanged data and ranks first among fourteen baselines, averages 0.829 balanced accuracy over 21 fault scenarios against 0.694 for the strongest baseline, and the TL;DR states a 2.7-point margin over the strongest of 14 baselines with 1/70 as many rewritten cells.

1HPggljzRo.one_liner: Four-level diagnostic benchmark of 1,474 cases testing controllable video world models from visual quality to world reactivity.
1HPggljzRo.problem: Existing benchmarks assess visual quality or explicit instruction fulfillment, leaving inherent reactivity, meaning plausible consequences not stated in the input, underexamined.
1HPggljzRo.method: WorldExam spans Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency and World Reactivity across eight tasks and supports camera-, action- and language-driven models; World Reactivity uses scene-conditioned reactions with unstated consequences and goal-directed behaviors with unspecified steps.
1HPggljzRo.key_idea: Test whether models infer unstated consequences of the scene state, rather than only following explicit controls.
1HPggljzRo.evidence: Evaluation of 23 models across the 1,474 cases.
1HPggljzRo.claimed_gains: not stated as gains; the abstract finds that neither high visual quality nor strong control adherence guarantees inherent reactivity.

uzzum63KP4.one_liner: Detects and constrains benchmark-wide shortcuts in automatic agent harness optimization using validity-preserving counterfactual benchmarks.
uzzum63KP4.problem: Task holdout leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a harness Proposer can improve on the released benchmark by exploiting a benchmark-wide shortcut.
uzzum63KP4.method: After each Proposer update, a Challenger searches for an executable protocol transformation with large gain destruction, a validity firewall checks that task semantics are preserved, and a held-out confirmation set decides whether the counterfactual enters a finite archive.
uzzum63KP4.key_idea: Cast harness evolution as constraint generation over valid counterfactual benchmarks, where a Challenger searches protocol transformations that destroy the Proposer's gains.
uzzum63KP4.evidence: Syn-Ledger, OfficeQA, FinanceBench and SWE-Bench Pro, plus theory linking finite counterfactual archives to an ideal shortcut-neutralized benchmark.
uzzum63KP4.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports improved released scores over the initial harness and the highest scores under the archived counterfactuals (abstract truncated).

CIzSDkezce.one_liner: Training-free KV eviction with diversity-aware layer and head budgets and spatial-temporal token score aggregation.
CIzSDkezce.problem: Existing KV eviction methods optimize cache allocation or importance aggregation without accounting for behavioral diversity across layers and heads or localized variations in token importance.
CIzSDkezce.method: Uniqueness-based layer budgets, head budgets in which behaviorally similar heads are clustered and compete only within their cluster, and token scores aggregated across head clusters and the query window to keep locally salient tokens.
CIzSDkezce.key_idea: Give larger budgets to layers with distinctive attention, cluster heads by behavior to limit budget competition, and aggregate token scores across clusters and the query window.
CIzSDkezce.evidence: LongBench, RULER and Needle-in-a-Haystack on Llama, Mistral and Qwen models.
CIzSDkezce.claimed_gains: not stated; the supplied abstract ends at 'With a cache budget of 512, it retains over'.

XjBn7gm35b.one_liner: Offline goal-conditioned RL that self-distills near-future-state teacher guidance into a goal-conditioned actor.
XjBn7gm35b.problem: In offline goal-conditioned RL, supervision for current decisions is weak when goals are distant, and privileged guidance must be selected and then transferred to a student that lacks it.
XjBn7gm35b.method: NEFD uses near-future states as teacher-only privileged information, weights teacher guidance by estimated goal progress, and performs action-distribution and decision-representation self-distillation within a shared actor.
XjBn7gm35b.key_idea: Use near-future states as teacher-only inputs, weight guidance by estimated goal progress, and distill the teacher's actions and representations into the same actor.
XjBn7gm35b.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract says NEFD improves policy learning, and the sentence is cut off.

dvMhjin9Mb.one_liner: VLM reasons about dynamic scenes with latent 4D imagery, trained by fine-tuning then text-restricted reinforcement learning.
dvMhjin9Mb.problem: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video is hard for VLMs: text-only reasoning is verbose and imprecise, and external geometric modules add inference complexity without building intrinsic ability.
dvMhjin9Mb.method: An annotation-free pipeline synthesizes 4D reasoning data from raw videos; Dynamic-Imagery Fine-Tuning (DIFT) jointly supervises text tokens and 4D latents; 4D Reinforcement Learning (4DRL) uses outcome-based rewards while restricting policy gradients to text tokens.
dvMhjin9Mb.key_idea: Have the VLM simulate scene evolution in continuous hidden 4D latents supervised alongside text, then run RL with gradients on text tokens only.
dvMhjin9Mb.evidence: Multiple dynamic spatial reasoning benchmarks (not named in the abstract).
dvMhjin9Mb.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract claims consistent improvement over strong baselines.

axer3X7DeD.one_liner: Unreal Engine 3D-particle rain dataset of 600,000 1080p frame pairs for nighttime video deraining, with a Wan 2.2 baseline.
axer3X7DeD.problem: Small synthetic datasets use 2D rain overlays that miss colored, locally illuminated night rain, so models generalize poorly to real night rain, and real paired data cannot isolate rain from other degradations.
axer3X7DeD.method: Simulates rain as 3D particles in Unreal Engine virtual environments and adapts the Wan 2.2 video generation model as a video-to-video deraining baseline.
axer3X7DeD.key_idea: Render physically grounded 3D rain particles with scene lighting to get paired data, and treat deraining as video-to-video generation with a pretrained generative prior.
axer3X7DeD.evidence: Benchmarking showing that models trained on the dataset generalize better to real-world videos.
axer3X7DeD.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the dataset has 600,000 1080p frame pairs and models trained on it generalize significantly better to real-world videos.

owqAp6CZZn.one_liner: Unlearns individual samples in ViTs by contrasting attention-masked images as positives against originals as negatives.
owqAp6CZZn.problem: Random data forgetting, which removes individual samples while keeping others of the same class, is hard for approximate unlearning, especially in Vision Transformers.
owqAp6CZZn.method: Masking a small proportion of the highest-attention patches preserves ViT recognition while making membership harder to determine; Lethe uses masked images as positive logits and original images as negative logits in a contrastive loss.
owqAp6CZZn.key_idea: Push the model away from sample-specific detail and toward category-level outlines by contrasting high-attention-masked images with the originals.
owqAp6CZZn.evidence: Selective masking experiments, and benchmarks on multiple ViT architectures against approximate unlearning methods with a retain-only Retrain reference.
owqAp6CZZn.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract claims Lethe surpasses existing approximate unlearning methods in most evaluated settings and has the closest gap to Retrain.

SGpeYjd8rc.one_liner: Kalman filter over the history of quantized denoiser outputs recovers full-precision outputs during diffusion sampling.
SGpeYjd8rc.problem: Sampling-stage correction for quantized diffusion models relies mainly on local information and underuses trajectory history, so errors propagating across timesteps stay uncorrected.
SGpeYjd8rc.method: QuAKE combines a smooth trajectory prior with a conditional Gaussian observation model, recursively updates the posterior over an output window in closed form, and feeds the posterior mean to the sampler; it is plug-and-play and supports high-order multistep ODE samplers.
SGpeYjd8rc.key_idea: Treat full-precision denoiser outputs as latent states of a Kalman filter with a smooth trajectory prior, observed through noisy quantized outputs.
SGpeYjd8rc.evidence: Experiments across W4A4-quantized text-to-image diffusion models.
SGpeYjd8rc.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports consistently reduced distributional discrepancy from full-precision sampling relative to existing methods.

bj9eweyHAF.one_liner: Test-time discovery that picks which saved policy checkpoint to resume training from under the current solution archive.
bj9eweyHAF.problem: Test-time training continues from the latest policy, but a policy's behavior depends on the evolving Solution Archive, and earlier checkpoints can outperform the latest one under a later archive.
bj9eweyHAF.method: PAST keeps a Policy Archive of historical trainable states and lets learning resume from a historical state under the current Solution Archive, creating a new continuation branch.
bj9eweyHAF.key_idea: Treat the starting policy of each test-time update as a search decision over archived historical checkpoints rather than always the latest.
bj9eweyHAF.evidence: Re-evaluating policies saved at different training stages under the same later Solution Archive reorders their relative performance; the instantiation details are cut off in the supplied abstract.

Wgqx6XoFe1.one_liner: Recurrent controller refines one intermediate diffusion activation within a single sampling trajectory, scaling test-time compute without extra candidates.
Wgqx6XoFe1.problem: Diffusion test-time scaling typically spends extra compute on generating, evaluating or revising multiple candidates.
Wgqx6XoFe1.method: At a fixed intervention point, the frozen generator computes an intermediate activation once, and a lightweight prompt- and state-conditioned controller recurrently applies the same learned transition for an inference-chosen number of steps before generation resumes. Reward-Ascent Matching (RAM) learns the transition from black-box rewards, and optional Reward-Flow Calibration (RFC) recalibrates it on states reached by the controller's own updates.
Wgqx6XoFe1.key_idea: Learn one reusable activation transition by fitting reward changes to activation displacements within sample groups (secant directions), then apply it recurrently to a single internal state.
Wgqx6XoFe1.evidence: Three diffusion backbones and four target rewards: RAM alone gives consistent reward improvements, RFC adds further gains, and gains grow with refinement steps across the calibrated range; neither stage backpropagates through the generator or reward model.

Qiqe1Y76r4.one_liner: Two-stage RL trains an MLLM to diagnose image quality as Where-What-How, with perception-gated rewards and online hard-example degradation generation.
Qiqe1Y76r4.problem: MLLM-based image quality assessment mostly predicts holistic quality as a black box, giving little insight into where distortions occur and how they affect perceived quality.
Qiqe1Y76r4.method: GS-IQA reformulates IQA as progressive Where-What-How diagnosis. The glance stage uses a perception-gated reward that activates severity feedback only once localization and recognition are correct, and the scrutiny stage uses online reward-conditioned degradation generation to synthesize hard examples; the paper also builds the Diag-Bench region-level benchmark.
Qiqe1Y76r4.key_idea: Gate the severity reward on correct localization and distortion recognition, then synthesize degradations targeted at the model's perceptual bottlenecks during RL.
Qiqe1Y76r4.evidence: Diag-Bench, about 25K curated region-level samples spanning 12 distortion types and five ordinal severity levels (the abstract is truncated before the results).

yHgPnzpuOx.one_liner: Metric-scale VLM with a depth adapter and progressive state chain predicts distances, motion, and spatial relations in future video frames.
yHgPnzpuOx.problem: Existing VLMs and spatial-reasoning benchmarks focus on observed scenes, leaving prediction of future spatial states underexplored.
yHgPnzpuOx.method: SpatialMind adds a metric depth adapter that anchors spatial reasoning to real-world scale and a progressive state chain that establishes current spatial states and observed dynamics before future prediction. A data engine grounded in metric geometry produces the SpatialMind-30K training set and the SpatialMind-2K benchmark across driving and everyday egocentric scenes.
yHgPnzpuOx.key_idea: A metric depth adapter fixes real-world scale and a progressive state chain builds current and observed-dynamics states as the basis for predicting future distances, motion, and relations.
yHgPnzpuOx.evidence: Evaluation on the SpatialMind-2K benchmark (eight tasks across current-state, observed-dynamics, and future-prediction levels) against general and spatially specialized models, plus zero-shot results on other benchmarks (truncated in the abstract).

8orH0Fnngx.one_liner: Training-free medical segmentation by steering a frozen unified multimodal model with anatomy-aware retrieval, editing, and quality critique.
8orH0Fnngx.problem: Medical segmentation models generalize poorly beyond their training distributions, and pixel-level annotations for adaptation are usually unavailable.
8orH0Fnngx.method: SegBanana recasts segmentation as structured visual generation with a frozen unified multimodal model (e.g., Nano Banana), adding Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval of in-context exemplars, repeated sampling, targeted editing, and Comparative Quality Critique.
8orH0Fnngx.key_idea: Recast segmentation as visual generation and refine a frozen unified multimodal model's masks via retrieved anatomical exemplars, repeated sampling, editing, and comparative critique.
8orH0Fnngx.evidence: Preliminary findings that frontier unified multimodal models show basic segmentation across diverse clinical scenarios; the abstract is cut off before the full results.

mrNTcCHM6j.one_liner: Forecasts by matching future to historical exogenous patterns in a tree that adaptively adds exogenous variables as matching conditions.
mrNTcCHM6j.problem: Direct modeling of exogenous effects is hard because they are complex and change with the exogenous pattern, and matching on many exogenous variables forces a tradeoff between precise matching and sufficient historical support.
mrNTcCHM6j.method: XMatch builds a ProtoTree with the ProtoTree Creator that organizes historical exogenous-to-endogenous pattern correspondences, with deeper levels adding more exogenous variables as matching conditions. It adaptively sets how many variables are used and uses the matched endogenous patterns to enhance forecasting.
mrNTcCHM6j.key_idea: Organize historical exogenous-endogenous pattern pairs in a ProtoTree whose deeper levels add exogenous variables, adaptively choosing how many to match on.
mrNTcCHM6j.evidence: not stated; the abstract is cut off before the experiments.

E9Avk25Ui3.one_liner: Per-document LoRA memories on a shared query-prefix KV cache, with routing to select a memory and Self-Gating to decide activation.
E9Avk25Ui3.problem: With a collection of context-distilled memories, existing work does not address which memory is relevant to a query and whether the selected memory should be activated at all.
E9Avk25Ui3.method: Cache-compatible context distillation represents each document as an independent LoRA adapter trained to operate on a query-prefix KV cache from the frozen base model. External retrieval gives a candidate set, internal routing selects one candidate, and Self-Gating decides whether to activate it.
E9Avk25Ui3.key_idea: Train document LoRA adapters against a shared frozen-model prefix cache so memory selection and a gate on activation can run without recomputing the prefix.
E9Avk25Ui3.evidence: Experiments on NarrativeQA, SQuAD and LongBench, and the same selection strategy applied to latent-token memories.

ZzyYLZ432M.one_liner: raFLoRA splits local LoRA updates into rank partitions, aggregating each by its effective client contributions.
ZzyYLZ432M.problem: In heterogeneous-rank FedLoRA with SVD-based allocation, rank collapse concentrates the global update's energy in the minimum shared rank, hurting performance and making it sensitive to rank configurations.
ZzyYLZ432M.method: raFLoRA decomposes local updates into rank partitions and aggregates each partition weighted by the clients that actually contribute to it. Theory traces the collapse to rank-agnostic aggregation weights that suppress higher-rank updates at a geometric rate.
ZzyYLZ432M.key_idea: Weight each rank partition by its effective client contributions rather than rank-agnostic weights, so higher-rank updates are not geometrically suppressed over rounds.
ZzyYLZ432M.evidence: Experiments across vision, language, and reasoning tasks against strong FedLoRA baselines, plus a theoretical analysis of the collapse.
ZzyYLZ432M.claimed_gains: Prevents rank collapse and improves performance and robustness across heterogeneous configurations; no numbers stated.

AhtSX5A2yj.one_liner: Fuses modalities by orthogonally splitting the instance matrix into a rank-one consensus subspace and an Eckart-Young complement.
AhtSX5A2yj.problem: Full alignment of modalities discards modality-specific information and no rule states how much to retain, while fusion losses are balanced by hand.
AhtSX5A2yj.method: PRISM exactly decomposes the instance matrix into a rank-one consensus part and its Eckart-Young residual (the complement), and realizes a Bayes-optimal predictor that adds a consensus score weighted by the leading right singular vector to individually shrunk complement scores.
AhtSX5A2yj.key_idea: Rank-one truncation spans a consensus subspace and its residual carries modality-specific innovation; predict from consensus plus shrunk complement scores, which is Bayes-optimal under a linear-Gaussian latent model.
AhtSX5A2yj.evidence: A proof that full alignment incurs excess risk equal to the label variance explained by modality-specific latents, and a Bayes-optimal predictor under a linear-Gaussian latent model; experiments are cut off in the abstract.

uhw8IUte6F.one_liner: Ranks task-level agent reliability from unlabeled traces by replaying recorded histories through the acting model and reading event-aligned statistics.
uhw8IUte6F.problem: An agent's execution record exists before an external evaluator returns an outcome, but it is unclear whether the model's own unlabeled traces reveal how reliably it handles a fixed task.
uhw8IUte6F.method: A rollout-replay protocol collects repeated natural executions, replays their histories through the original model, and reads intrinsic statistics (Level and Dispersion) at action and post-observation events. Measurement rules are fixed on discovery batch A before evaluation on new execution seeds in batch B.
uhw8IUte6F.key_idea: Replay recorded agent histories through the acting model and read event-aligned intrinsic statistics, Level and Dispersion, as task-level reliability signals.
uhw8IUte6F.evidence: Multiple benchmarks including held-out MCPMark, discovery batch A versus new-seed batch B, and a cross-model replay comparison.
uhw8IUte6F.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract says event-aligned readouts rank reliability more accurately than whole-trajectory statistics, without numbers)

8U2jJQ7hCz.one_liner: Builds flow-matching paths for sign language production on the joint-rotation manifold, combining a geodesic with a learned naturalness-guided deviation.
8U2jJQ7hCz.problem: Flow-matching sign language production interpolates linearly between motions, which leaves the manifold of valid joint rotations and ignores the motion distribution on it.
8U2jJQ7hCz.method: SignNMFlow constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold using its intrinsic geometry and a motion naturalness measure. Minimizing kinetic energy under this measure yields an interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic with a learnable deviation.
8U2jJQ7hCz.key_idea: Minimize kinetic energy under a motion-naturalness measure to learn a path that adds a learnable deviation to a closed-form manifold geodesic.
8U2jJQ7hCz.evidence: The abstract mentions extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations but is cut off before datasets or metrics.

5ymFUwVAdV.one_liner: Training-free decomposition of VLM representations into redundant, unique, and synergistic parts, then amplification along the vision-unique subspace at inference.
5ymFUwVAdV.problem: VLMs under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context.
5ymFUwVAdV.method: GeoPID decomposes multimodal information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components using geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. It then selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference, without parameter updates.
5ymFUwVAdV.key_idea: Partial information decomposition computed from the geometry of visual and textual subspaces, with inference-time amplification of the vision-unique component.
5ymFUwVAdV.evidence: Analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks showing that correct predictions have stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding, followed by the steering intervention.
5ymFUwVAdV.claimed_gains: Average relative accuracy gain of 7.63% without any additional model parameter updates.

3lIZSoGERt.one_liner: Merges task-specific VLA experts after post-training with a shared action interface and LoRA-only updates, using context-guided sparse weights.
3lIZSoGERt.problem: Co-training multi-task VLA policies can underperform per-task training, and merging independent experts fails partly because task-specific changes to the action interface (normalization, encoder, decoder) make them incompatible.
3lIZSoGERt.method: During post-training all experts keep the base policy's action interface and adapt only through LoRA updates in the action model's hidden layers. At deployment, PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, selects the expert set by leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a fixed sparse weighted merge for the task.
3lIZSoGERt.key_idea: Keeping the action interface frozen makes LoRA experts mergeable, and the initial visual-language context selects and weights which experts to merge sparsely.
3lIZSoGERt.evidence: GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks; the rest of the evaluation is cut off in the abstract.
3lIZSoGERt.claimed_gains: not stated; the visible abstract is cut off before the results.

WDqqlQFZkT.one_liner: Streaming joint audio-video generator with hierarchical context routing and timestamp-based attention biases for asynchronous multi-track instructions.
WDqqlQFZkT.problem: Global conditioning and segment-level prompt switching do not support dynamically arriving controls with asynchronous, overlapping intervals in interactive joint audio-video generation.
WDqqlQFZkT.method: Hierarchical Context Routing connects event-level instructions to blockwise generation through coarse-to-fine conditioning, with an online prompt queue admitting new instructions at block boundaries, while Temporal Attention Bias aligns instruction intervals with audio-video query positions on a shared timeline. A causal model is composed with a pretrained distillation LoRA and trained with self-forcing distribution matching, without an ODE-based initialization stage.
WDqqlQFZkT.key_idea: Timestamp-dependent cross-attention biases align instruction intervals to audio-video positions on a shared physical timeline, while a prompt queue routes only relevant events to each causal window.
WDqqlQFZkT.evidence: Experiments on the new MTBench for multi-track instruction adherence, temporal alignment, and joint audiovisual quality; baselines and details are cut off in the abstract.
WDqqlQFZkT.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract claims support for asynchronous, overlapping, and dynamically arriving controls without numbers.

4FkJyWVvR7.one_liner: Dual-timescale medical time-series classifier: fast encoder plus slow-evolving non-parametric class-evidence dictionary read by hierarchical routing.
4FkJyWVvR7.problem: Existing MedTSC methods encode class knowledge in parameters or prototypes optimized on the same gradient timescale as the encoder, mixing transient within-sample structure with persistent cross-sample class evidence.
4FkJyWVvR7.method: ProtoRoute couples a fast parametric encoder with a slow-evolving non-parametric class-evidence dictionary. Token-Class-Prototype Slot routing (Top-r prototype and Top-q token aggregation) reads from the dictionary, and Loss-Adaptive Prototype Evolution updates it at the epoch level.
4FkJyWVvR7.key_idea: Separate transient within-sample encoding from persistent class evidence kept in a slowly updated prototype dictionary, read by Top-r/Top-q routing and updated by loss-adaptive replacement.
4FkJyWVvR7.evidence: Experiments on 8 datasets; the abstract does not name the datasets or baselines.

mSO30AmGJA.one_liner: An Evolutionary Task Generator builds linked tasks to measure how LLM reasoning changes across workflows and corrupted contexts.
mSO30AmGJA.problem: LLMs increasingly operate in complex workflows and noisy contexts, but it is unclear how performance varies across workflow and corruption types and whether both harmful and beneficial transitions occur.
mSO30AmGJA.method: The Evolutionary Task Generator (ETG) generates series of linked tasks across workflows and corruptions, used to analyze performance changes, bidirectional transitions under corrupted contexts, and training effects.
mSO30AmGJA.key_idea: Generate chains of linked tasks across workflow types and corruption types so the same problem can be traced from direct solving to downstream reuse.
mSO30AmGJA.evidence: Evaluations of frontier LLMs across workflows and corruptions, instance-level transition analysis, and training experiments.
mSO30AmGJA.claimed_gains: Analysis finding rather than a method gain: DeepSeek-V4-Flash drops from 0.75 in direct solving to 0.20 in downstream reuse.

j8fLzLZ27h.one_liner: Learns low-bit LLM quantization rotations as short chains of Householder reflections, with projection-guided learning.
j8fLzLZ27h.problem: Dense learned rotations in LLM quantization need quadratic learned state and costly optimization, and at non-foldable interfaces they stay on the inference path with quadratic storage and computation.
j8fLzLZ27h.method: MirrorQuant parameterizes rotations with short chains of Householder reflections, which preserve exact orthogonality, keep learned state linear in the rotation dimension for fixed depth, and allow log-linear online execution without dense matrices. Projection-guided learning adds a penalty on quantization distortion after the immediate downstream linear projection.
j8fLzLZ27h.key_idea: Parameterize learned orthogonal rotations as short Householder-reflection chains, and train them to minimize distortion after the downstream projection as well as representation reconstruction error.
j8fLzLZ27h.evidence: 23 matched settings spanning model families, scales, and low-bit configurations, compared against DartQuant on 0-shot_9 accuracy.
j8fLzLZ27h.claimed_gains: Improves 0-shot_9 accuracy over DartQuant in every one of 23 matched settings.

cFOUBOLS88.one_liner: Anchors GRPO groups on the logged exposed item, with propensity correction and asymmetric handling of positive and no-response feedback.
cFOUBOLS88.problem: Continual updates of LLM recommenders see only policy-shaped bandit feedback, with outcomes observed solely for items a prior policy exposed, causing exposure bias and mixing reliable positives with ambiguous no-responses.
cFOUBOLS88.method: ABPO inserts the exposed recommendation as a logged anchor into each GRPO rollout group so group-relative normalization is calibrated against the action actually exposed, and applies self-normalized inverse propensity scoring to the anchor for both feedback types. It treats positive responses and ambiguous no-responses asymmetrically to avoid aggressive updates (abstract truncated).
cFOUBOLS88.key_idea: Insert the logged exposed item into each GRPO group as a fixed anchor, correct it with self-normalized IPS, and weight positives and ambiguous no-responses differently.
cFOUBOLS88.evidence: not stated (the abstract is cut off before the experiments).

JZJgzbuurd.one_liner: Aligns an agent's hidden states at every layer to a skill-conditioned copy of itself, rather than distilling token probabilities.
JZJgzbuurd.problem: Privileged self-distillation through token probabilities misses most of a skill's effect: a skill lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2% yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of sampled tokens.
JZJgzbuurd.method: After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective. It needs no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead.
JZJgzbuurd.key_idea: Distill a skill-conditioned self-teacher by projected hidden-state alignment at every layer, since a skill changes hidden states of over 80% of tokens but few token probabilities.
JZJgzbuurd.evidence: ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones compared with GRPO, plus probing analyses showing linear probes can trace changed hidden states back to the specific skill.
JZJgzbuurd.claimed_gains: Best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy.

UjqmDDReJi.one_liner: Autoencoder that binds wider latents with random keys and superposes them in one memory tensor, recovering each before decoding.
UjqmDDReJi.problem: Autoencoders meet tight latent-memory budgets by shrinking each latent, which sacrifices representational capacity.
UjqmDDReJi.method: SLAE transforms latents into storage-friendly codes, binds them with randomized keys, superposes multiple codes into a single memory tensor, and learns to recover each latent before decoding.
UjqmDDReJi.key_idea: Store several wide latents in superposition through random-key binding and learned recovery, replacing irreversible dimension reduction with interference that can be suppressed.
UjqmDDReJi.evidence: CIFAR-10/100, SVHN, STL-10, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet-1K across a range of memory budgets, plus downstream classification on the preserved information.
UjqmDDReJi.claimed_gains: Reconstruction error drops by up to 56%, including 20.6% on ImageNet-1K over conventional autoencoders at matched storage, and downstream classification improves by up to 16.79 percentage points under the same memory budget.

vRTeXiSknb.one_liner: Predicts long-horizon volumetric deformable-body dynamics in one shot with latent diffusion over a spatiotemporal VAE of mesh sequences.
vRTeXiSknb.problem: Autoregressive step-by-step simulation lacks global temporal context for long-horizon consistency, while direct multi-frame prediction is computationally prohibitive at native resolution on 3D volumetric meshes.
vRTeXiSknb.method: A holistic spatiotemporal VAE (ST-VAE) compresses mesh dynamics into a latent space, and a latent-diffusion model performs one-shot volumetric deformable simulation; the abstract also asks whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion suits the task, and is cut off before the findings.
vRTeXiSknb.key_idea: Compress whole mesh-dynamics sequences into a spatiotemporal latent that avoids video-VAE staircase artifacts, then predict that latent with diffusion in one shot.
vRTeXiSknb.evidence: Reconstruction precision of the ST-VAE on meter-scale scenes; downstream diffusion experiments are cut off in the visible abstract.
vRTeXiSknb.claimed_gains: The ST-VAE achieves about 2.48 mm precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression.

7Et5MDmRRV.one_liner: PACE diagnoses LLM physics-reasoning failures as observed, stable or attributable using repeated measurement and controlled probe synthesis.
7Et5MDmRRV.problem: An observed physics error may vanish on repetition, may not survive reformulation, or may arise from a different reasoning breakdown, so accuracy alone does not show a recurring weakness.
7Et5MDmRRV.method: PACE combines selective repeated measurement, mechanism-abstracted Difficulty Cards, controlled probe synthesis, scientific validation and source-relative attribution to test whether the same reasoning breakdown recurs.
7Et5MDmRRV.key_idea: Abstract each failure into a mechanism-level Difficulty Card, synthesize controlled probes, and test whether the same breakdown recurs, separating observed, stable and attributable evidence.
7Et5MDmRRV.evidence: Frontier reasoning models across multiple physics subfields, including an atomic evaluation of failed probe-target observations.
7Et5MDmRRV.claimed_gains: Strict mechanism recurrence reaches only 56.4% among failed probe-target observations in the atomic evaluation, and repeated failure, source-guided probe failure and error-category agreement are each useful but incomplete evidence.

6ge2NdeE7W.one_liner: SealKV quantizes the KV cache with trellis codes on sealed token blocks after subtracting a shared per-channel offset.
6ge2NdeE7W.problem: Existing KV-cache quantization methods require offline calibration, lose accuracy at low bit widths, or save memory without a measured speedup.
6ge2NdeE7W.method: Quantization runs in sealed blocks, each coded by a trellis-coding quantizer only once all its tokens have arrived, which exposes a subtractable per-channel offset shared by neighboring tokens. Fused dequantization-attention kernels read the codes directly and reconstruct values in registers.
6ge2NdeE7W.key_idea: Code tokens in sealed blocks so trellis encoding is decoupled from the newest token and a shared per-channel offset can be subtracted before quantization.
6ge2NdeE7W.evidence: Evaluations including GPT-OSS-120B retrieval and decode throughput in vLLM; subtracting the offset also improves three existing quantizers on GPT-OSS-120B retrieval.
6ge2NdeE7W.claimed_gains: Calibration-free, effectively lossless at 3 bits or more, and up to 3.44x BF16 decode throughput in vLLM; offset subtraction lifts three existing quantizers by up to 32 points on GPT-OSS-120B retrieval.

hpBZ1MDrqI.one_liner: Drag-based image editing that converts handle-target instructions into task-specific canny-map guidance during inversion and denoising.
hpBZ1MDrqI.problem: Sparse drag point instructions are ambiguous between local deformation, line bending and region transformation, and existing motion supervision constrains only neighborhoods around handle points.
hpBZ1MDrqI.method: CannyDrag adds canny guidance during inversion to keep the inverted latent compatible with the later denoising trajectory, manipulates the canny map according to the selected task type (point, line or region), and injects the transformed canny condition progressively during denoising.
hpBZ1MDrqI.key_idea: The canny edge map is transformed per task type and injected progressively during denoising, turning sparse drag instructions into structural guidance.
hpBZ1MDrqI.evidence: Experiments on point-, line- and region-level drag tasks.

WOPC9RASkf.one_liner: Question-guided memory for video spatial reasoning that injects camera-conditioned geometry and scores frames by question relevance and novelty.
WOPC9RASkf.problem: Spatial video-language models treat memory as a generic temporal cache, which brings in redundant or irrelevant evidence and weakens long-horizon reasoning.
WOPC9RASkf.method: Q-GeoMem injects camera-conditioned geometry into visual tokens and keeps a Fine-Grained Context Bank for recent dense context and a Semantic-Geometric Evidence Bank for compact long-range evidence. Each candidate frame is scored by calibrated question relevance and novelty against the active bank, and this utility drives memory replacement and reading.
WOPC9RASkf.key_idea: Frame utility from calibrated question relevance and novelty relative to the active memory bank controls both memory replacement and memory reading.
WOPC9RASkf.evidence: Experiments on two in-domain and five out-of-distribution benchmarks, plus controlled analyses of question-guided geometric evidence selection.
WOPC9RASkf.claimed_gains: Reports best performance in the evaluated settings on two in-domain and five out-of-distribution benchmarks; no numbers stated.

CmUuIRtIeu.one_liner: Models memory staleness for LLM agents with latent validity under a Markov-modulated hazard and Beta-Bernoulli quality per memory.
CmUuIRtIeu.problem: Agent knowledge of tools, interfaces, and codebases goes stale as the environment changes, yet existing harnesses update memory only after errors without modelling how knowledge expires.
CmUuIRtIeu.method: Each memory carries a binary latent validity that fails at a Markov-modulated hazard and is restored only by a rewrite, plus a Beta-Bernoulli model of success rate conditional on validity, with memories sharing statistical strength within each subsystem pool.
CmUuIRtIeu.key_idea: Treat staleness as a generative process: latent validity with Markov-modulated expiry plus pooled Beta-Bernoulli success-rate quality decides which memories to maintain.
CmUuIRtIeu.evidence: Two new datasets, MASKEDMIG (157 real API changes from 18 Python libraries) and ACMESDK (company SDK benchmark based on SOP-Bench), with models from 4B to 27B and two closed-weight Gemini models.
CmUuIRtIeu.claimed_gains: Best maintenance policy on every model tested (abstract truncated before the numbers); numeric gains not stated.

v1ej7lNxh7.one_liner: Unrolls variational mean-field inference in a text-conditioned energy model into a compact network for referring expression segmentation.
v1ej7lNxh7.problem: Deep unfolding has centered on recovering latent coefficients under predefined structural priors, not on language-conditioned semantic posterior inference.
v1ej7lNxh7.method: LUMIN builds a semantic state space from textual hypotheses plus an adaptive background state, couples a text-derived Gram compatibility kernel with a symmetric visual affinity graph, and propagates evidence through simplex-constrained Softmax updates; a background-relative differential readout calibrates marginal log-odds.
v1ej7lNxh7.key_idea: Each unfolded stage is a surrogate step on the variational free energy of a text-conditioned energy model, propagating language evidence over a visual affinity graph on a probability simplex.
v1ej7lNxh7.evidence: Experiments on RefCOCO/+/g showing step-wise posterior refinement with only three unfolding (abstract truncated).
v1ej7lNxh7.claimed_gains: Competitive segmentation performance on RefCOCO/+/g; no numeric gains stated.

fVlHzXO4UN.one_liner: Causal state-transplant experiments show frozen language models store reusable meaning for novel word forms inferred from prior usages.
fVlHzXO4UN.problem: It is unclear when a novel form starts to function as a word, meaning a cue for reusing semantic information inferred from earlier usages, rather than just being interpretable in context.
fVlHzXO4UN.method: On Qwen3-8B and Gemma-3-4B, the authors reverse the meaning assignments of two novel forms and check which form the model selects, then transplant internal states produced by preceding usages into new judgments to separate their influence from the original examples.
fVlHzXO4UN.key_idea: Transplanting internal states from earlier usages into new judgments isolates the semantic influence carried by the form-meaning relation, independent of the source examples.
fVlHzXO4UN.evidence: Qwen3-8B and Gemma-3-4B; meaning reversal changes which form is selected for held-out situations; transplanted states guide judgments of unseen usages even without the source definition; form-meaning consistency is varied with sentences, order, length, and form frequency fixed.

hYEPYy0e8d.one_liner: Allocates mixed-precision bit widths using depth error propagation: each precision change's response one layer deeper and at the model output.
hYEPYy0e8d.problem: Mixed-precision quantization methods set bit allocation from single-layer information, miss effects in deeper layers, and fall well short of full precision.
hYEPYy0e8d.method: DepthQuant ranks precision changes by the response they induce one layer deeper, adjusts the allocation by the error's effect on the model output, and sets each row's range from information in its own layer.
hYEPYy0e8d.key_idea: Spend the bit budget where extra precision most reduces the measured downstream response change, using depth error propagation instead of single-layer sensitivity.
hYEPYy0e8d.evidence: Comparisons against baselines in most evaluated settings, including every reported average-2-bit setting, with perplexity and zero-shot accuracy results (abstract truncated).
hYEPYy0e8d.claimed_gains: Reduces perplexity by up to 40.6% at 2.5-bit average precision relative to the best-performing baseline and raises zero-shot accuracy by up (abstract truncated before the figure).

IRSjL2IEF3.one_liner: Benchmark for multi-turn image generation and editing using a simulated-user loop with turn-level and session-level assessment.
IRSjL2IEF3.problem: Existing benchmarks score static output quality on isolated capabilities and neglect the dynamic, multi-turn interaction requirements users meet in practice.
IRSjL2IEF3.method: A hybrid dataset of user-generated, professionally generated, and LLM-synthesized data with a capability and scenario taxonomy; a multi-model collaborative simulator runs interaction loops; a dual-layer assessment measures turn-level quality and session-level coherence; automated attribution analysis produces structured diagnostic reports.
IRSjL2IEF3.key_idea: Replace static scoring with simulated multi-turn interaction loops, assessed at turn and session level, with automated attribution of failure causes.
IRSjL2IEF3.evidence: Experiments on multiple image generation and editing models; attribution analysis points to unintended background alterations (abstract truncated).

MK8wTYoUQo.one_liner: Streaming VLM coach with joint-coordinate Form Tokens and a gated Motion State updated every chunk, independent of feedback generation.
MK8wTYoUQo.problem: Coaching models trained on short single-exercise segments break down on continuous streams, since earlier movement evidence is not kept for later feedback and its relevance must change at exercise transitions.
MK8wTYoUQo.method: Form Tokens encode each chunk in anatomical joint coordinates grounded in person-centered visual features, and a gated Motion State is updated from them at every chunk whether or not feedback is generated.
MK8wTYoUQo.key_idea: Decouple movement memory from feedback generation: a gated Motion State over joint-coordinate Form Tokens updates every chunk so evidence persists across repetitions and exercise transitions.
MK8wTYoUQo.evidence: QEVD workouts processed as continuous streams without context reset at exercise boundaries, compared with segment-trained coaches and a streaming backbone fine-tuned under the same protocol, with component ablations and separately adapted probes.
MK8wTYoUQo.claimed_gains: Improves reference-based feedback content and response timing over a streaming backbone fine-tuned under the same protocol; no numbers stated.

9HapN0eCTb.one_liner: Domain-generalizing classifier that learns primitive heatmaps and scores soft unary, binary, and ternary spatial predicates over them.
9HapN0eCTb.problem: Existing domain generalization methods leave the shared compositional structure implicit, overlooking a more reliable source of invariance across domains that differ in color, texture, or style.
9HapN0eCTb.method: CRISP combines a visual backbone, a concept bottleneck layer that maps features to primitive heatmaps with differentiable spatial coordinates, and a structural scoring layer that evaluates candidate spatial relations through soft predicates, trained end-to-end.
9HapN0eCTb.key_idea: Factor recognition into localized visual primitives and their relational composition, scored with differentiable soft spatial predicates, as an explicit structural inductive bias.
9HapN0eCTb.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before the experiments; datasets and settings are not stated.

c8pCCILIne.one_liner: Model merging that preserves load-bearing-wall dimensions, task-critical knowledge left in pretrained weights, while merging task vectors.
c8pCCILIne.problem: Task Arithmetic-style merging assumes task knowledge sits only in task vectors, but some task-critical knowledge stays in the pretrained weights, so ignoring it leaves task conflicts unresolved and can damage task-specific knowledge.
c8pCCILIne.method: The authors characterize Load-Bearing Wall (LBW) dimensions from scalar-weight and subspace perspectives, and PACT preserves these anchored task-specific cores within task vectors during merging (abstract truncated).
c8pCCILIne.key_idea: Identify LBW dimensions where task-critical knowledge remains in pretrained weights, and protect these anchored cores when merging in task-vector space.
c8pCCILIne.evidence: Analysis of LBW dimensions across scalar-weight and subspace views covering major merging paradigms; experimental results are cut off in the abstract.

bqu17MhkDo.one_liner: Plug-and-play, model-agnostic input-representation enhancement for medical time series classification, improving the data rather than the classifier.
bqu17MhkDo.problem: Medical time series classification has pursued increasingly complex architectures, overlooking the quality and discriminability of the input signals themselves.
bqu17MhkDo.method: CIF is a simple framework that enhances medical time series representations before classification and attaches to existing classifiers without changing their designs; the abstract does not describe its internal operation.
bqu17MhkDo.key_idea: Improve input representations before classification via a model-agnostic fusion step (named Channel-Imposed Fusion); the exact operation is not described in the abstract.
bqu17MhkDo.evidence: Experiments across diverse medical time series datasets and representative classification architectures.
bqu17MhkDo.claimed_gains: Consistent and substantial classification improvements across datasets and architectures; no numbers stated.

pmgK8Kn99Z.one_liner: Contrasting current visual attention against moving-average history recalibrates visual value vectors during decoding to reduce MLLM relation hallucinations.
pmgK8Kn99Z.problem: Multimodal LLMs exhibit visual inertia during relation description, lingering on previously dominant image regions instead of shifting focus across interacting objects.
pmgK8Kn99Z.method: Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE) dynamically recalibrates visual values at each decoding step by contrasting current token-level visual attention against recent moving averages. This contrast reinforces emergent visual tokens with rising relevance while mildly attenuating persistently dominant regions.
pmgK8Kn99Z.key_idea: Contrast current-step visual attention against recent moving averages during MLLM decoding to amplify newly relevant visual tokens and attenuate repeatedly attended regions.
pmgK8Kn99Z.evidence: Supported by attention-history analyses and evaluated across three multimodal LLMs and multiple decoding strategies on relation hallucination and general multimodal benchmarks.

XArkvfc1NN.one_liner: Transforms structured pathology long-term knowledge into context-grounded working memory via a Memory Transformer for whole-slide MLLMs.
XArkvfc1NN.problem: Multimodal large language models in computational pathology lack explicit memory mechanisms to ground visual morphology in structured taxonomies and grading criteria.
XArkvfc1NN.method: PathMem stores structured pathology taxonomies and diagnostic criteria in a long-term memory bank and introduces a Memory Transformer that dynamically activates and grounds relevant entries into working memory conditioned on visual context. The refined working memory guides downstream whole-slide report generation and diagnostic reasoning.
XArkvfc1NN.key_idea: Use a Memory Transformer with multimodal activation and context-aware grounding to convert structured pathology long-term memory into case-specific working memory.
XArkvfc1NN.evidence: Evaluated on whole-slide image benchmarks including WSI-Bench report generation and open-ended diagnostic tasks against prior WSI-based models.
XArkvfc1NN.claimed_gains: Improves WSI-Bench report generation by +13.0% WSI-Precision and +11.1% WSI-Relevance, and improves open-ended diagnosis by +9.7% and +8.9% over prior WSI-based models.

kX5cwrt2Zo.one_liner: Trained solely on synthetic quadratic patches, a Point Transformer predicts unsigned distances, normals, and curvatures for point-cloud meshing.
kX5cwrt2Zo.problem: Surface reconstruction and differential-quantity estimation from unoriented point clouds are typically solved separately or require costly per-shape optimization.
kX5cwrt2Zo.method: PatchGF encodes local point patches with a Point Transformer trained exclusively on synthetic quadratic surfaces, using query-to-patch cross-attention and dedicated heads to jointly predict unsigned distances, unoriented normals, and mean and Gaussian curvatures. At inference, overlapping anchor-centered patch predictions are fused into a global unsigned distance field for level-set extraction and curvature-guided adaptive remeshing.
kX5cwrt2Zo.key_idea: Train a shared Point Transformer solely on synthetic quadratic patches to jointly predict local unsigned distances, normals, and curvatures for feed-forward fusion and adaptive meshing.
kX5cwrt2Zo.evidence: Evaluated zero-shot on standard 3D reconstruction and differential-geometry benchmarks as well as real-world point-cloud scans.

lupv2l5ib1.one_liner: Predicts synthetic data training utility without retraining by estimating local parameter shifts and target-loss changes via Godambe information.
lupv2l5ib1.problem: Distribution similarity fails to predict whether synthetic images help downstream tasks, while retraining models to evaluate every candidate synthetic set is computationally prohibitive.
lupv2l5ib1.method: Interventional Godambe Risk Tomography (IGRT) fits a single reference model on real data and approximates local parameter shifts induced by candidate synthetic samples while accounting for parameter sampling uncertainty. It uses these shifts to estimate changes in target negative log-likelihood, flagging harmful augmentations and ranking candidate subsets without retraining.
lupv2l5ib1.key_idea: Approximate candidate synthetic data's effect on target negative log-likelihood via local parameter-shift estimates under Godambe information from a single real-data reference model.
lupv2l5ib1.evidence: Controlled experiments varying candidate labels, data coverage, and augmentation size, plus subset-selection evaluations across multiple downstream vision tasks against distribution- and valuation-based baselines.

5LaVWdURJZ.one_liner: Co-evolves agent skills and policies using Wasserstein-distance rewards computed from a learned skill-conditioned trajectory velocity field.
5LaVWdURJZ.problem: Self-evolving LLM agents stagnate over successive rounds because extracted skills become misaligned with ongoing policy optimization.
5LaVWdURJZ.method: SCALE learns a skill-conditioned velocity field that predicts how candidate skills shift the agent's trajectory distribution. It scores and evolves skills jointly with the policy using an evolution-aware reward based on the Wasserstein distance toward a reward-reweighted target trajectory distribution.
5LaVWdURJZ.key_idea: Model skill-induced trajectory shifts with a learned velocity field and reward candidate skills by their Wasserstein distance to a reward-reweighted target distribution.
5LaVWdURJZ.evidence: Evaluated across diverse model scales on nine benchmarks covering scientific reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, GUI control, and environment learning.

GKfHMfcFnO.one_liner: Rebuilds low-rank Adam second-moment state after subspace refreshes by resetting bias-correction age to match the rebuilt statistic.
GKfHMfcFnO.problem: Subspace refreshes in low-rank optimizers appear to require carrying stale second-moment history or post-reset warmup because rebuilt statistics are miscalibrated against the global step counter.
GKfHMfcFnO.method: The authors isolate history loss from bias-correction miscalibration across low-rank optimizers by resetting the statistical age counter of Adam's second moment whenever the subspace refreshes instead of using the global step count. They also analyze state-dependent failure regimes where intermittent oversized gradients destabilize fresh second-moment reconstruction.
GKfHMfcFnO.key_idea: Calibrate reconstructed Adam second-moment statistics after each low-rank subspace refresh using their post-refresh statistical age rather than the global training step.
GKfHMfcFnO.evidence: Controlled experiments at 60M and 1B scales across GaLore, PLUMAGE, Fira, SPAM, and ReLoRA.
GKfHMfcFnO.claimed_gains: Erasing both moments degrades GaLore-60M perplexity by 1.36× versus 11.82× when erasing second moments alone, and statistical-age calibration keeps three GaLore-1B runs within 0.6% of carry baselines.

7yegfIsdbX.one_liner: Evolves an embodied agent's context memory and hierarchical skill stack from execution traces across heterogeneous robots.
7yegfIsdbX.problem: Embodied agent frameworks tune isolated prompts or modules rather than converting execution traces into validated, transferable updates across the full context-and-skill system.
7yegfIsdbX.method: RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps from execution traces to generate validated updates over two surfaces: an active-and-filesystem context manager and a hierarchical skill library with failure-conditioned recovery. Recurring task-level edits are promoted to the general system behind a shared semantic interface that decouples high-level decisions from robot-specific execution.
7yegfIsdbX.key_idea: Treat the embodied agent harness—spanning persistent filesystem context and hierarchical recovery skills—as a unified policy updated through trace-driven diagnosis and validation.
7yegfIsdbX.evidence: Evaluated on EmbodiedBench across multiple foundation models including GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.7-Plus and across heterogeneous robot embodiments.
7yegfIsdbX.claimed_gains: Improves GPT-5.5 by 27.8% on EmbodiedBench and brings Qwen3.7-Plus to 70.3% compared with 72.7% for GPT-5.5.

pWMzmShz76.one_liner: Simulates explicit 3D hand-object trajectories and rasterizes pixel-aligned surface maps to condition interactive video world generation.
pWMzmShz76.problem: Direct action-conditioned video generators entangle physical 3D contact dynamics with visual appearance synthesis, producing physically implausible hand-object interactions.
pWMzmShz76.method: HandWM reconstructs initial 3D hand pose and object geometry from an input frame, simulates future 3D hand-object trajectories from control signals, and rasterizes target-view surface maps capturing visibility and occlusion. A bidirectional geometry-appearance module then exchanges features between these pixel-aligned geometric maps and the video generator.
pWMzmShz76.key_idea: Decouple hand-object video prediction into physics-simulated 3D trajectory rollout followed by video synthesis conditioned on rasterized, occlusion-aware surface maps.
pWMzmShz76.evidence: Evaluated on controllable hand-object interaction video generation measuring visual quality and interaction accuracy; specific datasets are truncated in the abstract.

KNK5aUOnD9.one_liner: Separately supervises positive predictions and classifier-free guidance directions to prevent branch-error cancellation in on-policy diffusion distillation.
KNK5aUOnD9.problem: Matching only CFG-combined velocities during on-policy diffusion distillation leaves individual branches under-identified, inflating negative-branch errors when teachers hold privileged conditioning.
KNK5aUOnD9.method: The authors characterize Negative Branch Asymmetry under asymmetric teacher-student conditioning and introduce Positive-Direction Matching (PDM), an on-policy distillation loss that separately constrains the positive-branch prediction and the conditional CFG direction. They apply PDM to distill dense-to-sparse controllable video diffusion teachers.
KNK5aUOnD9.key_idea: Decompose CFG on-policy distillation into separate losses on the positive conditional branch and the conditional-minus-unconditional guidance direction.
KNK5aUOnD9.evidence: Theoretical branch-identifiability analysis of two contrasting conditioning regimes and empirical evaluation on dense-to-sparse controllable video generation across inference guidance scales.

tdqDGwIkHa.one_liner: Offloads fixed-length latent reasoning to FHE ciphertexts on the server while decoding vocabulary tokens locally on the client.
tdqDGwIkHa.problem: Token-by-token autoregressive LLM decoding under fully homomorphic encryption requires costly, error-prone vocabulary-wide selection operations at every generation step.
tdqDGwIkHa.method: TELEX splits inference so the server executes fixed-length reasoning steps in encrypted latent space using a layout-compatible FHE KV-cache decoding scheme, avoiding vocabulary-level ciphertext operations. A lightweight client-side model then decrypts the returned reasoning latents and generates the final text answer locally.
tdqDGwIkHa.key_idea: Run fixed-length latent-space reasoning homomorphically on the server with layout-compatible KV caching and defer vocabulary token decoding to a local client model.
tdqDGwIkHa.evidence: Evaluated on secure autoregressive reasoning tasks including GSM8K-Aug under fully homomorphic encryption.
tdqDGwIkHa.claimed_gains: Fixed-length encrypted latent reasoning reduces server-side encrypted decoding from an average of 26.7 steps to 5 steps on GSM8K-Aug.

jXKheJJhHs.one_liner: Extracts single-layer meshes with exact non-manifold junctions from neural unsigned distance fields via ball-induced cospherical Voronoi sites.
jXKheJJhHs.problem: Mesh extraction methods for neural unsigned distance fields struggle to recover clean single-layer connectivity where multiple surface sheets meet at non-manifold junctions.
