jXKheJJhHs.method: VoroFacet extracts an initial mesh from Voronoi facets of an adaptive ball cover over a double-layered UDF proxy, detects non-manifold curves, and places balls along those junctions to induce cospherical Voronoi sites. Re-extracting facets forces incident sheets to share junction vertices and edges, followed by a three-stage geometric optimization.
jXKheJJhHs.key_idea: Place adaptive balls along detected junction curves to create cospherical Voronoi sites whose shared facets weld incident surface sheets at non-manifold junctions.
jXKheJJhHs.evidence: Evaluated on surface reconstruction benchmarks from neural unsigned distance fields with emphasis on non-manifold junction topology and geometry.

GGxISIBAYu.one_liner: SPECTRA predicts LoRA learning rates from initialization-time gradient spectral decay and rank using a calibrated log-linear model.
GGxISIBAYu.problem: LoRA fine-tuning remains sensitive to learning-rate choice, and configuration-specific selection often requires costly hyperparameter sweeps.
GGxISIBAYu.method: SPECTRA maps initial gradient spectral decay and LoRA rank to a stable learning rate through a calibrated log-linear predictor. Local stability analysis identifies the most fragile module as the shared-rate bottleneck and characterizes idealized Adam gradient-scale invariance.
GGxISIBAYu.key_idea: Use initialization-time gradient spectral decay and adaptation rank as inputs to a calibrated learning-rate predictor.
GGxISIBAYu.evidence: Rank-constrained stability analysis accompanies empirical comparisons with sweep-free baselines and exhaustive per-dataset grid search.
GGxISIBAYu.claimed_gains: SPECTRA achieves an 88.5% success rate, exceeds sweep-free baselines by over 9.7 points, and recovers 89% of exhaustive-search coverage at 4% of its time cost.

wJdmPx189t.one_liner: ACT-LAM extracts action cues with gated queries and conditions evolving state representations through progressively interacting action tokens.
wJdmPx189t.problem: Low reconstruction error can mask nuisance-sensitive action extraction and forward models that bypass inferred actions through current-state shortcuts.
wJdmPx189t.method: The Action Query inverse dynamics model uses learnable action queries and gated aggregation to select action-related transition cues. The Action Token forward dynamics model projects latent actions into tokens that progressively interact with evolving state representations, with streamlined feature processing concentrating capacity on dynamics.
wJdmPx189t.key_idea: Use gated action queries to extract transition cues and repeatedly condition forward state updates through interacting action tokens.

DluPNPqS2E.one_liner: TempoMark assigns watermark bits to temporal slots and injects spread-spectrum chips during audio denoising for matched-filter recovery.
DluPNPqS2E.problem: Post-hoc audio watermarks can be removed, while unstructured generative perturbations entangle payload bits and degrade recovery as payloads grow.
DluPNPqS2E.method: TempoMark assigns each bit a time slot, expands it into spread-spectrum chips, and injects a chip-aligned residual at an intermediate denoising step. Decoding applies matched filtering within each bit's chips, supported by a lightweight neural residual and a small injection adapter.
DluPNPqS2E.key_idea: Bind each payload bit to a dedicated temporal chip pattern shared by diffusion-time injection and matched-filter decoding.

ZDx5RN3YOE.one_liner: DIGAA separates bridge-entity-guided retrieval from final information selection and answering in diffusion language models.
ZDx5RN3YOE.problem: Broad parallel retrieval in diffusion language models supplies useful knowledge alongside noise that can impair answer accuracy.
ZDx5RN3YOE.method: DIGAA first uses bridge entities generated during intermediate reasoning to explore external knowledge and collect facts. A separate answer-generation phase selects and integrates those facts into a direct answer.
ZDx5RN3YOE.key_idea: Decouple exploratory bridge-entity retrieval from the subsequent selection and integration of facts for answer generation.
ZDx5RN3YOE.evidence: Experiments evaluate Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-8B-Instruct across six factual question-answering benchmarks against the strongest baseline for each benchmark and metric.
ZDx5RN3YOE.claimed_gains: DIGAA improves Dream's average EM and F1 by 4.10 and 5.16 percentage points, respectively, relative to the strongest per-benchmark, per-metric baselines.

Vya5rcQHsQ.one_liner: ReCAP calibrates cross-view prototypes through sample-mediated round-trip transitions that encourage reciprocal one-to-one matches.
Vya5rcQHsQ.problem: Missing views and feature noise destabilize prototypes, making cross-view correspondences ambiguous and prone to many-to-one matches.
Vya5rcQHsQ.method: Mutual nearest-neighbor graph contrastive learning stabilizes local neighborhoods and prototype estimates without imputation. ReCAP maximizes return probabilities through sample-mediated cross-view prototype cycles and applies a visitation regularizer to prevent mass collapse.
Vya5rcQHsQ.key_idea: Maximize cyclic return probability from a source prototype through another view and back while regularizing prototype visitation.
Vya5rcQHsQ.evidence: The paper proves that zero cyclic loss makes the two directional transitions a permutation and its inverse, establishing reciprocal one-to-one correspondence.

ti6LHD6u2q.one_liner: GeoRoute selects a sample-specific denoising state and compatible frequency components for single-state geometric prior injection.
ti6LHD6u2q.problem: Persistent geometric guidance can inject three-dimensional priors at denoising states or frequencies poorly matched to evolving video representations.
ti6LHD6u2q.method: A Timestep Router selects a compatible intermediate denoising state, and a Spectral Router selects which geometric frequency components to transfer. Decoupled training separates three-dimensional/video alignment from post-intervention denoising, while GeoVideoBench supports reference-free temporal-geometry evaluation.
ti6LHD6u2q.key_idea: Adapt both the denoising timestep and transferred frequency components when injecting a three-dimensional prior once per sample.
ti6LHD6u2q.evidence: Trajectory analysis finds sample-dependent compatibility peaks at intermediate denoising states and differing compatibility across frequency components.

R8EcOvc8nz.one_liner: IMUG-Bench tests interleaved image-text understanding and generation across multiple dialogue turns to expose generation-side exposure bias.
R8EcOvc8nz.problem: Single-turn and static benchmarks miss interaction-dependent failures and exposure bias in unified multimodal models.
R8EcOvc8nz.method: IMUG-Bench organizes multi-turn image-text interactions into Static Spatial, Temporal Causal, and Hybrid classes with dynamic understanding questions. It jointly evaluates understanding and generation, then probes chain-of-thought, self-verification, and best-of-N test-time strategies.
R8EcOvc8nz.key_idea: Evaluate understanding and generation within evolving interleaved dialogues so errors can affect subsequent interaction turns.
R8EcOvc8nz.evidence: Experiments evaluate open-source and closed-source unified multimodal models on 3,113 samples and 12,034 interaction turns, including test-time scaling strategies.

7iAs5HIXay.one_liner: Attention-head activation graphs reveal small-world reasoning correlations and guide hierarchical pruning through within-community and cross-community connectivity scores.
7iAs5HIXay.problem: Behavioral scores alone leave unclear how language-model reasoning relates to internal functional organization and attention-head importance.
7iAs5HIXay.method: The study builds functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and measures small-world organization, within-community core scores, and cross-community bridge scores. Small-World Allocation uses these scores to guide hierarchical sparsity allocation in pruning.
7iAs5HIXay.key_idea: Use attention-head similarity graphs and community connectivity scores to allocate pruning sparsity according to structural indicators of reasoning importance.
7iAs5HIXay.evidence: The study reports small-world-index correlations with fluid reasoning across models and checkpoints and tests pruning through Small-World Allocation across six LLMs.

v3XsDN0NWx.one_liner: MemOPSD selectively distills a memory-specialized teacher onto recurring interaction samples while retaining the original generative recommendation objective.
v3XsDN0NWx.problem: Memory specialization can improve recurring recommendation transitions while conflicting with generalization gradients and reducing overall performance.
v3XsDN0NWx.method: The framework divides interactions into memory and generalization subsets according to recurring cross-user transition support. MemOPSD trains a memory-specialized teacher and uses on-policy self-distillation selectively on memory samples while keeping the original objective on all instances.
v3XsDN0NWx.key_idea: Restrict memory-teacher distillation to recurring-transition examples while applying the original recommendation objective to every training instance.
v3XsDN0NWx.evidence: Subset analysis reports memory-specialization tradeoffs and frequent gradient conflicts between memory and generalization interactions; benchmark details are not stated.

jD0sBMOSeK.one_liner: CorVer converts corpus co-occurrence counts for extracted subject-object pairs into sentence-level reinforcement-learning rewards for factual question answering.
jD0sBMOSeK.problem: Response-level rewards can miss factual sentence errors, while repeated neural-verifier inference makes process supervision expensive.
jD0sBMOSeK.method: A 0.5B extractor identifies subject-object pairs, and indexed corpus queries return their co-occurrence counts. CorVer derives sentence rewards from these statistics and assigns them to the corresponding tokens during reinforcement learning.
jD0sBMOSeK.key_idea: Reward response tokens using sentence-level corpus co-occurrence statistics for extracted subject-object pairs.
jD0sBMOSeK.evidence: Evaluation covers six models from three families across five factual-QA benchmarks, with four factuality-RL baselines and Qwen3-4B/8B training-time comparisons.
jD0sBMOSeK.claimed_gains: CorVer reduces mean complete training time by 5.5–10.4× and speeds reward computation by 4.3–95×, achieves the highest accuracy in 17 of 20 baseline-comparison settings, and improves all 30 standard factual-QA settings over unmodified models.

aIcF3ZTtBi.one_liner: Task- and cache-type-specific compression policies share a storage budget through attention-guided allocation and temporal scheduling.
aIcF3ZTtBi.problem: Uniform KV compression degrades unified multimodal models because different tasks activate cache types with distinct attention patterns and temporal behavior.
aIcF3ZTtBi.method: UniCache identifies task-activated cache segments and assigns compression policies by segment type without training. It coordinates parallel compression with attention-guided budget allocation and task-aware temporal scheduling.
aIcF3ZTtBi.key_idea: Assign compression policies to task-activated cache types and coordinate them through shared-budget allocation and task-dependent scheduling.
aIcF3ZTtBi.evidence: Experiments assess compression quality and throughput for understanding, editing, and generation in unified multimodal models.
aIcF3ZTtBi.claimed_gains: UniCache compresses KV cache 5× for understanding and editing and 2.5× for generation with negligible loss, increasing throughput up to 1.78×.

gSEJggpNLO.one_liner: Teacher takeover rollouts repair next-token scoring before agentic on-policy distillation.
gSEJggpNLO.problem: A teacher can complete tasks from student states while its myopic token scores still permit delaying actions that exhaust the student's turns.
gSEJggpNLO.method: R2S mines high-disagreement states from an untrained student and runs teacher takeovers. It retains states with enough takeovers passing reward-free checks and fine-tunes the teacher using takeover-informed scoring before distillation.
gSEJggpNLO.key_idea: Use reward-free-validated teacher takeovers from student disagreement states to fine-tune the teacher's token scorer before distillation.
gSEJggpNLO.evidence: The supplied text reports that teacher takeovers can finish tasks from high-disagreement student states while token-score-trained students run out of turns.

FhQVcAsQCC.one_liner: Reference-corpus binding checks separate seen and unseen compositions for controlled vision-language evaluation.
FhQVcAsQCC.problem: Compositional benchmark scores can overstate generalization when most evaluated attribute-object combinations already occur in training data.
FhQVcAsQCC.method: BindSplit classifies attribute-object bindings as seen or unseen using a reference corpus approximating training data. BindSplit Bench balances those groups, shares attributes across them, and applies the same generation and human-review pipeline.
FhQVcAsQCC.key_idea: Split attribute-object examples by reference-corpus binding occurrence and compare matched seen and unseen benchmark partitions.
FhQVcAsQCC.evidence: The study audits existing benchmarks against CC12M and evaluates 75 VLMs on seen and unseen attribute-object bindings.
FhQVcAsQCC.claimed_gains: Existing benchmarks contain at most 88 unseen-binding samples each against CC12M, and 72 of 75 VLMs lose accuracy on unseen bindings.

2OGCbGlynS.one_liner: Prior-weighted Hessian correction and lengthscale refitting address disconnected comparison graphs in preferential Bayesian optimization.
2OGCbGlynS.problem: Disconnected pairwise-comparison graphs leave relative utilities to the GP prior, while poorly fitted lengthscales weaken coupling between components.
2OGCbGlynS.method: Precision-Weighted Refit adds a diagonal Hessian correction during MAP estimation, weighted more strongly where prior precision is low. It refits lengthscales using Laplace evidence at that estimate without adding the correction to EUBO's posterior precision.
2OGCbGlynS.key_idea: Correct the MAP Hessian according to prior precision and refit lengthscales while leaving the acquisition posterior's precision uncorrected.
2OGCbGlynS.evidence: Experiments use 13 benchmarks with 60 paired seeds and analyze lengthscale behavior on problems with 14 to 20 dimensions over 200 comparisons.
2OGCbGlynS.claimed_gains: PWR lowers mean remaining regret on all five problems with 14 to 20 dimensions.

SJoq0w7xiP.one_liner: Retrospective context lets an agent re-score its own actions and distill those scores into its policy.
SJoq0w7xiP.problem: Naturally collected agent trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier rewards needed for learning.
SJoq0w7xiP.method: Retrospective Self-Distillation gives the same model privileged context containing cross-task precedents, lessons, turn-level reflections, and future hindsight. It distills the resulting action distributions into the policy and refreshes precedents and lessons as the experience bank grows.
SJoq0w7xiP.key_idea: Re-score past actions with privileged hindsight from accumulated experience, then distill those distributions into the acting policy over multiple rounds.

vJEyLPn7WD.one_liner: Target-token membership in a teacher's top-K predictions gates distillation to preserve domain-relevant generation.
vJEyLPn7WD.problem: Distillation from a distant teacher can improve held-out prediction while degrading generation quality.
vJEyLPn7WD.method: Domain-Anchored KD applies a supervised training-time gate to the teacher KL term. The gate retains distillation only when the observed target token falls within the teacher's top-K predictions.
vJEyLPn7WD.key_idea: Retain the teacher KL loss only when the observed target token belongs to the teacher's top-K predictions.
vJEyLPn7WD.evidence: Experiments span text, MAESTRO audio, and protein models, with GPT-2 and Gemma 4 analyses of KL weighting and teacher-domain adaptation.
vJEyLPn7WD.claimed_gains: Format-only teacher adaptation recovers 41-81% of the generation-quality gain from target-domain adaptation in the reported GPT-2 comparison.

nToSp3fyTi.one_liner: Layer-wise null-space projection constrains post-merge hallucination adaptation to preserve inherited expert capabilities.
nToSp3fyTi.problem: Multimodal model merging increases hallucination, while unconstrained mitigation can damage inherited expert abilities.
nToSp3fyTi.method: MergeHEIR collects merged-model activations on small expert-task calibration sets and derives layer-wise null-space projectors using SVD. During adaptation, it periodically projects accumulated parameter displacement into those null spaces.
nToSp3fyTi.key_idea: Project accumulated post-merge updates into layer-wise activation null spaces derived from expert-task calibration data.
nToSp3fyTi.evidence: The paper gives distortion, dimensionality, and perturbation guarantees and evaluates 24 paired comparisons across three MLLM configurations and eight merging methods.

e6EDwcIko1.one_liner: Shared-initial-image trajectories supply one reinforcement-learning advantage to jointly train reflection tokens and image revisions.
e6EDwcIko1.problem: Reflection-format supervision and single-head reinforcement learning do not jointly teach which multi-round reflections improve rendered images.
e6EDwcIko1.method: UMM-Reflection compares sibling reflection trajectories starting from the same image using group-relative advantages. A single trajectory-level advantage jointly updates reflection tokens and flow-based image revisions across multiple rounds.
e6EDwcIko1.key_idea: Compare reflection trajectories sharing an initial image and apply one trajectory-level advantage to both reflection tokens and image-revision updates.

sJTg2nqPy6.one_liner: Structured event evidence and group-relative reward weighting balance video-reasoning accuracy, schema compliance, and token budget.
sJTg2nqPy6.problem: Verbose reasoning obscures visual evidence, while fixed reward weights impose rigid trade-offs between correctness and reasoning length.
sJTg2nqPy6.method: Structured Event Evidence organizes video reasoning around a shared temporally ordered schema. GRAB computes minimum-norm objective weights from centered rewards within each rollout group entirely in reward space.
sJTg2nqPy6.key_idea: Compute minimum-norm objective weights from group-centered rewards to balance schema compliance, task accuracy, and reasoning budget.
sJTg2nqPy6.evidence: The supplied abstract reports runtime overhead for reward-space weighting but truncates before identifying the reference runtime.
sJTg2nqPy6.claimed_gains: GRAB reports <0.002% relative runtime overhead; the reference runtime is not stated in the supplied abstract.

x8p9dJmBKl.one_liner: Uncertainty-guided latent task expansion and meta-critic filtering train offline meta-RL policies for shifted contexts.
x8p9dJmBKl.problem: Offline meta-RL policies fail when test-time contexts come from behavior policies different from those represented in fixed training data.
x8p9dJmBKl.method: MADE prioritizes high-variance regions using an uncertainty-aware memory bank and synthesizes latent tasks through interpolation and conservative extrapolation. A meta-critic filters synthetic data by consistency, diversity, and causality.
x8p9dJmBKl.key_idea: Expand uncertain latent task regions with counterfactual tasks, then filter synthetic data through a meta-critic before offline training.
x8p9dJmBKl.evidence: Evaluations test out-of-distribution performance and performance retention across five benchmarks.
x8p9dJmBKl.claimed_gains: MADE improves out-of-distribution performance by up to 13.10% and achieves up to 94.36% performance retention.

MZ7kcOOYa3.one_liner: Dense retrieval and reranking over raw conversation history test the necessity of complex agentic memory.
MZ7kcOOYa3.problem: The need for complex memory mutation, organization, and learned retrieval remains unclear for long-term conversation understanding.
MZ7kcOOYa3.method: Raw-RAG retrieves and reranks raw conversation history to supply evidence to a reader LLM. The study compares memory systems and analyzes coverage and use of answer values, relations, and dependency paths.
MZ7kcOOYa3.key_idea: Retrieve and rerank untransformed conversation history directly as evidence for a reader LLM.
MZ7kcOOYa3.evidence: Experiments cover LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench across seven benchmark-model settings, with evidence-coverage and transformed-memory analyses.
MZ7kcOOYa3.claimed_gains: Raw-RAG ranks first in six of seven benchmark-model settings, exceeding the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13--5.53 points in those settings.

dmjb7OlIC4.one_liner: Fingertip-anchored fusion connects local vision and tactile context to sound while training on incomplete multimodal demonstrations.
dmjb7OlIC4.problem: Spatial and temporal differences complicate multisensory fusion, and requiring every modality excludes otherwise usable demonstrations.
dmjb7OlIC4.method: DexMuse uses calibrated fingertip projections to associate local vision with tactile and proprioceptive context, then attends from region tokens to acoustic history alongside global vision. Availability-aware training incorporates demonstrations missing touch or sound into ACT and π0.5 policies.
dmjb7OlIC4.key_idea: Anchor multimodal features at fingertip contact regions and train the same policy on demonstrations with varying modality availability.
dmjb7OlIC4.evidence: Experiments evaluate ACT and π0.5 integrations on seven real-world single-arm and bimanual tasks, including mixed training with incomplete demonstrations.
dmjb7OlIC4.claimed_gains: DexMuse averages 0.70 success with ACT and 0.80 with π0.5 versus 0.35 and 0.52 for concatenation, while adding incomplete demonstrations improves success by 0.19 on average.

qDtekgrzCb.one_liner: Observed mobility choices and shared navigation-tool replay evaluate personalization and broader human-centered agent outcomes.
qDtekgrzCb.problem: Existing mobility benchmarks insufficiently assess behavioral alignment alongside broader human-centered outcomes under one protocol.
qDtekgrzCb.method: MobiLens combines real user queries, pre-query context, and observed mobility decisions. It measures personalization, diversity, fairness, explainability, and robustness alongside tool-use success and operational efficiency under offline navigation-tool replay.
qDtekgrzCb.key_idea: Compare agent recommendations with observed user mobility decisions under a shared tool-replay protocol and human-centered outcome measures.
qDtekgrzCb.evidence: The benchmark evaluates 11 agent configurations spanning reasoning, memory augmentation, multi-agent coordination, and recommendation-oriented designs.

DqQf4Zia2s.one_liner: Policy-trained feature aggregation and latent next-scene prediction construct a navigation representation from frozen vision encoders.
DqQf4Zia2s.problem: Vision-encoder pretraining objectives largely determine navigation representations instead of the navigation policy's own learning objectives.
DqQf4Zia2s.method: RepresentNav uses a three-layer transformer to attend across the full depth of complementary vision foundation models. Before each action, latent chain-of-thought predicts the next scene representation through joint JEPA training with prediction loss and target regularization.
DqQf4Zia2s.key_idea: Learn navigation-specific mixtures of frozen encoder features and predict future representations in the same space before acting.
DqQf4Zia2s.evidence: Evaluations cover VLNVerse, VLN-CE R2R, EVT-Bench, two point-goal benchmarks, and a physical robot amid clutter and moving people.

upF1dhkGSK.one_liner: Adaptive multi-Gaussian latent pivots reduce velocity ambiguity in composition-consistent image translation.
upF1dhkGSK.problem: Controlled translation needs compositional consistency and source sensitivity, but a shared Gaussian pivot can induce ambiguous conditional velocities.
upF1dhkGSK.method: AP-FM factors conditional transport through a shared latent pivot and replaces the standard Gaussian prior with trainable multi-Gaussian modes. A frozen reference field defines prior-mode adaptation loss, while the source determines the pivot at inference.
upF1dhkGSK.key_idea: Factor translations through a shared pivot whose multi-Gaussian prior modes adapt using a frozen reference velocity field.
upF1dhkGSK.evidence: The paper gives exact-integration composition and source-sensitivity guarantees and evaluates SRN Cars and DeepFashion across autoencoders and backbones.

EzAvLxV9UE.one_liner: Neighbor geometry and physical relations condition object generation for coherent single-image 3D scene reconstruction.
EzAvLxV9UE.problem: Independent or implicitly coupled object generation provides insufficient guidance for fine-grained compatibility between interacting scene objects.
EzAvLxV9UE.method: Tetris3D conditions each object's shape and pose on surrounding geometry and physical relationships. The accompanying ComOb dataset uses physics simulation to provide interacting scenes with per-object meshes and pairwise relation annotations.
EzAvLxV9UE.key_idea: Condition each generated object's geometry and pose explicitly on neighboring object shapes and pairwise physical relationships.
EzAvLxV9UE.evidence: Experiments cover synthetic and real scenes, including occluded interactions, and introduce ComOb with 1.2M physics-simulated scenes.

4t6aJxVlqz.one_liner: Two entropy-coded networks regenerate Gaussian positions and attributes from deterministic samples instead of storing individual primitives.
4t6aJxVlqz.problem: Gaussian splatting storage grows with high-precision primitive positions even though multiple Gaussian configurations can render the same scene.
4t6aJxVlqz.method: GSRC maps deterministic pseudo-random samples to a coarse point cloud, then predicts Gaussian attributes using a second network with multiresolution hash tables. Rate-aware training and entropy coding compress the resulting network parameters.
4t6aJxVlqz.key_idea: Represent Gaussian geometry and attributes as outputs of two networks, then entropy-code the networks after rate-aware training.

PJ9QZAYNO6.one_liner: Digital-twin failure exploration and real-world DAgger jointly train task execution and verified recovery policies.
PJ9QZAYNO6.problem: Manipulation failures can create states outside a task policy's recovery abilities, while corrective behavior needs scalable exploration and physical validation.
PJ9QZAYNO6.method: Recova diagnoses failures and tests recovery programs in a digital twin to train separate execution and recovery policies. During deployment it verifies restoration before resuming, and routes physical rollouts and human demonstrations into DAgger updates.
PJ9QZAYNO6.key_idea: Train separate task and recovery policies from digital-twin trials, then refine both with routed physical rollouts and human interventions.
PJ9QZAYNO6.evidence: Experiments cover six LIBERO-Pro settings, four MolmoSpaces categories, four real-robot workstations, and repeated human-assisted collection rounds.
PJ9QZAYNO6.claimed_gains: Recova achieves 78.8% and 64.9% mean success versus 71.7% and 38.0%, raises real-robot success from 23.8% to 77.5% with DAgger and to 87.5% with recovery, and reduces observed intervention from 87.5% to 0% over four rounds on one task.

qVbOFzvpQh.one_liner: Counterfactual response ablation and terminal hindsight combine through confidence gating to estimate early-turn agent credit.
qVbOFzvpQh.problem: Critic-free credit estimates become unreliable early in long-horizon trajectories because sampling noise and weak outcome connections obscure action contributions.
qVbOFzvpQh.method: FOLIA estimates local action influence by counterfactually ablating the observed environment response. It anchors that influence to a terminal hindsight score and combines the signals with a confidence gate without extra rollouts.
qVbOFzvpQh.key_idea: Fuse counterfactual response-ablation influence with terminal hindsight through a confidence gate to reattribute early-turn credit.
qVbOFzvpQh.evidence: The supplied abstract reports theoretical and empirical evidence of early-turn credit failure in existing critic-free methods.

hhFWjKtY93.one_liner: Physical rewind interventions pair rejected and corrective robot actions for preference learning with branch-consistent credit.
hhFWjKtY93.problem: Post-error human interventions do not provide policy and corrective actions from the same state, causing critic extrapolation or misattributed recovery returns.
hhFWjKtY93.method: Efficient RLT reverse-replays robot waypoints to restore the pre-error state before collecting a human correction. It trains actor and critic with pairwise preferences, separates credit across branches, and adds a learned progress estimator for dense rewards.
hhFWjKtY93.key_idea: Rewind to pre-error states to pair rejected actions with human corrections, then learn preferences while keeping corrective returns out of rejected branches.

54MpfL8Iz3.one_liner: Bounded Softmax replacement and functional bootstrapping reduce encrypted transformer depth and control feature growth.
54MpfL8Iz3.problem: FHE transformer inference suffers from feature explosion and costly non-polynomial operations.
54MpfL8Iz3.method: CtrlFormer replaces Softmax with a bounded FHE-friendly alternative and combines activation evaluation with functional bootstrapping. Reduced multiplicative depth permits a smaller ciphertext modulus and faster homomorphic matrix multiplication.
54MpfL8Iz3.key_idea: Bound attention normalization and fuse activation evaluation with bootstrapping to reduce encrypted computation depth and ciphertext modulus.
54MpfL8Iz3.evidence: Evaluation uses a revised BERT-base model on a single GPU and compares performance on GLUE with prior methods.
54MpfL8Iz3.claimed_gains: CtrlFormer achieves an amortized inference time of 1.8 minutes per input for revised BERT-base on a single GPU.

c8pOKbbPaZ.one_liner: A two-layer mobile graph, incremental entity learning, and one-call retrieval planning enable smartphone graph-based RAG.
c8pOKbbPaZ.problem: Compact mobile models struggle with graph extraction, while cloud-oriented summaries require expensive large-context LLM calls.
c8pOKbbPaZ.method: MoRAG combines MRGraph's entity, relation, and source-paragraph structure with EvoNER's incremental entity-type learning and local graph updates. ATPlanner uses one LLM call to guide hybrid retrieval within a fixed budget.
c8pOKbbPaZ.key_idea: Combine a two-layer mobile graph with incremental entity updates and single-call planning for budgeted hybrid retrieval.
c8pOKbbPaZ.evidence: Experiments deploy MoRAG end-to-end on commercial smartphones and compare correctness, graph-construction speed, and energy use with prior mobile and lightweight methods.
c8pOKbbPaZ.claimed_gains: MoRAG improves correctness by up to 22.4 points, constructs knowledge graphs 13.77× faster, and uses only 1.36% of the energy of the compared lightweight methods.

abD5pDTs0I.one_liner: Self-supervised topology learning and optimal-transport graph alignment personalize federated multi-agent collaboration.
abD5pDTs0I.problem: Task-supervised communication topologies transfer poorly and isolate federated clients in task-specific knowledge silos.
abD5pDTs0I.method: FedGOTA fuses complementary collaboration views to train question-aware topology generators through a shared structural self-supervised objective. The server probes generators with semantic anchors and aligns their graph codebooks through optimal transport for personalized aggregation.
abD5pDTs0I.key_idea: Train task-label-free topology generators and personalize federated aggregation through optimal-transport alignment of anchor-probed graph codebooks.
abD5pDTs0I.evidence: Experiments evaluate six reasoning benchmarks across four task domains.

2e4rdUwCS3.one_liner: LiG-DETR reassembles magnified local features into global coordinates for joint decoding with full-image features.
2e4rdUwCS3.problem: Downsampling loses small-object detail, while independent image slicing fragments prediction and global context.
2e4rdUwCS3.method: A shared encoder extracts global and magnified local features, projects them into detector space, and reassembles local features at their original positions. One DETR decoder jointly processes both, while selective reassembly concentrates high-resolution encoding on informative regions.
2e4rdUwCS3.key_idea: Treat crops as local feature acquisition, spatially reassemble their features, and decode them jointly with global context.

lXA7bg9E4t.one_liner: A geometry-aware prefix from monocular RGB history conditions joint future-view and navigation-action generation.
lXA7bg9E4t.problem: Action-centric VLN lacks explicit visual dynamics, and existing continuous-navigation world-action models omit geometry-aware conditioning from observation history.
lXA7bg9E4t.method: WNM-3D uses a frozen geometry encoder and trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter to turn monocular history into a persistent fixed-length prefix for joint view-action generation. Training combines supervised world-action learning, DAgger-style adaptation, and Counterfactual DanceGRPO refinement.
lXA7bg9E4t.key_idea: Convert monocular observation history into a persistent geometry-aware token prefix that conditions future-view and action generation.
lXA7bg9E4t.evidence: Evaluations use 3DGS-based GN-Bench and VLN-CE, compare with WNM-2D and VLN baselines on GN-Bench, and include physical-robot deployment and component and training-stage ablations.

W9t6llGVV9.one_liner: Continuous latent-state propagation and event-driven observation updates separate shared multimodal dynamics from modality-specific sampling grids.
W9t6llGVV9.problem: Multimodal sequence models often conflate temporal evolution of information with the different observation grids of each modality.
W9t6llGVV9.method: BTS-Flow propagates a shared latent state between observations and updates it through modality-specific observation functions, separating common state information from private residuals. Timestamp-based acoustic and visual derivatives constrain latent velocity, while language enters only through event updates.
W9t6llGVV9.key_idea: Propagate a continuous latent state between events, update it through modality-specific observations, and constrain its velocity with acoustic and visual derivatives.
W9t6llGVV9.evidence: Evaluations on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS-v2 report improved standard predictive metrics over the strongest reported baselines.

lDbmdlRalC.one_liner: Sparse semantic action elements mapped into native video coordinates let heterogeneous actions condition one world model.
lDbmdlRalC.problem: Separate models for different action types fragment limited action-annotated world-model data.
lDbmdlRalC.method: UniAction represents each action as sparse elements combining discrete semantic identities and continuous spatiotemporal coordinates, then maps these coordinates into the video model's native positional space. Cardinality-calibrated attention compensates for different representation granularities.
lDbmdlRalC.key_idea: Encode heterogeneous actions as semantic elements with spatiotemporal coordinates and use cardinality-calibrated attention within a shared video positional space.
lDbmdlRalC.evidence: Experiments cover force, camera control, hand pose, and robot pose, comparing conditioning alternatives and a jointly trained model against action-specific experts.

ZsGi3Zx9Xn.one_liner: Optimal-response bias spans connect robust average-reward equilibria to discounted planning and finite-sample learning guarantees.
ZsGi3Zx9Xn.problem: Distributionally robust average-reward Markov games require conditions for equilibrium existence and tractable equilibrium learning.
ZsGi3Zx9Xn.method: The analysis introduces the uniform optimal-response bias span H_R and uses finite-span conditions to transfer discounted robust equilibria to average-reward equilibria. A model-based discounted learner combines generative-model sampling with an approximate Nash-equilibrium oracle under total-variation ambiguity.
ZsGi3Zx9Xn.key_idea: Bound robust optimal-response bias spans to transfer discounted equilibrium limits and approximation guarantees to average-reward Markov games.
ZsGi3Zx9Xn.evidence: Theorems establish equilibrium existence for finite H_R, bound average-reward equilibrium gaps, and derive sample complexity under total-variation ambiguity and balanced nominal generative-model sampling.

f3k5bkcD5o.one_liner: Depth-dependent latent steering and on-policy distillation implant reasoning attacks activated by extended computation.
f3k5bkcD5o.problem: Short-budget evaluations can miss computation-dependent failures that emerge when reasoning traces grow longer.
f3k5bkcD5o.method: TIDES uses a Depth-Guided Latent Tracker to inject small steering vectors into intermediate reasoning representations. On-policy distillation embeds the resulting computation-dependent behavior in reasoning models.
f3k5bkcD5o.key_idea: Inject depth-guided steering vectors into intermediate reasoning states and distill them into behavior that activates under extended reasoning.
f3k5bkcD5o.evidence: The paper derives a worst-case propagation bound and evaluates Phi-4-Reasoning and DeepSeek-R1-Distill Qwen-7B and Llama-8B on reasoning benchmarks against DecepChain and BadChain.
f3k5bkcD5o.claimed_gains: TIDES achieves an average 26.8% relative improvement in RAS over the strongest baseline while largely preserving short-budget utility.

qyCeaDLGdq.one_liner: Internal decision dynamics, evidence, and trajectories guide fine-tuning, reliability assessment, and correction in EEG foundation models.
qyCeaDLGdq.problem: EEG foundation-model outputs alone leave internal signals of prediction reliability and recoverable class information unused.
qyCeaDLGdq.method: GACE uses training-time Decision Dynamics to guide fine-tuning and models reliability through Decision Result and Decision Evidence. Decision Trajectory then supports correction of high-risk predictions without changing the backbone.
qyCeaDLGdq.key_idea: Use training dynamics for fine-tuning guidance, output and evidence signals for reliability modeling, and decision trajectories for prediction correction.

1T270uBjrz.one_liner: Pairwise token attributions and closed-form path aggregation trace multimodal evidence through intermediate vision-language reasoning.
1T270uBjrz.problem: Existing token-attribution methods can underweight visual evidence and miss its contributions through intermediate reasoning paths.
1T270uBjrz.method: VTrace constructs pairwise token attributions, aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form, and calibrates scores across image and text modalities.
1T270uBjrz.key_idea: Aggregate pairwise token contributions across all forward reasoning paths and calibrate attribution scores across modalities.
1T270uBjrz.evidence: An empirical study identifies visual underrepresentation in joint image-text attribution and underestimated contributions caused by tracing only limited reasoning paths.

IURFuR16tB.one_liner: Co-activation-aware expert placement and per-step local rebalancing reduce distributed MoE communication and workload imbalance.
IURFuR16tB.problem: Cross-node bandwidth and skewed expert workloads bottleneck expert-parallel training, while per-expert statistics overlook shared communication opportunities.
IURFuR16tB.method: Cobalt periodically places frequently co-activated experts on the same node and adjusts their layout within nodes at each step to rebalance workloads. A two-stage planner adapts to evolving co-activation and workload conditions.
IURFuR16tB.key_idea: Co-locate frequently co-activated experts across nodes and rebalance expert workloads within each node at every training step.
IURFuR16tB.evidence: Empirical observations show that individual tokens frequently co-activate particular expert pairs; the supplied abstract does not report benchmark results.

RSSLBLTQKV.one_liner: Replacing online selectors with benchmark-normal-only updates tests whether anomaly contamination explains time-series adaptation failures.
RSSLBLTQKV.problem: It remains unclear whether restricting adaptation to normal samples reliably improves reconstruction-based time-series anomaly detection.
RSSLBLTQKV.method: The study replaces practical update selection with benchmark-labeled normal-only selection while holding the rest of online adaptation fixed. It tests detection changes, reconstruction loss, alternative adaptation variants, and label perturbations.
RSSLBLTQKV.key_idea: Replace only the update selector with benchmark-normal-only selection to isolate its effect on detection and reconstruction objectives.
RSSLBLTQKV.evidence: Experiments span nine benchmark families, four optimizer configurations, and five random seeds, with alternative adaptation variants and modest benchmark-label perturbations.
RSSLBLTQKV.claimed_gains: Normal-only selection recovers a clear detection gain in 63 of 180 settings, while 90 still show no clear detection gain.

0LHbk2ORXK.one_liner: Motion-adaptive token allocation densifies fast-moving body regions and coarsens low-motion regions for human image animation.
0LHbk2ORXK.problem: Uniform patch grids give equal representation density to regions with unequal motion demands.
0LHbk2ORXK.method: MATA assigns finer representations to motion-intensive regions while compressing redundant tokens in low-motion regions, reallocating spatial capacity without uniformly increasing the token budget.
0LHbk2ORXK.key_idea: Allocate denser spatial tokens to motion-intensive body regions and compress tokens in low-motion regions.
0LHbk2ORXK.evidence: HyperMotionX experiments compare MATA with UniAnimate-DiT 5B using FVD, PCK_bbox@0.05, and estimated main-DiT FLOPs.
0LHbk2ORXK.claimed_gains: MATA reduces FVD by 7.97% and increases PCK_bbox@0.05 by 6.54 percentage points with a 1.29% increase in estimated main-DiT FLOPs.

NTYGJJSxHv.one_liner: Latent geometry rewards and camera-corrected appearance rewards jointly optimize stochastic flow trajectories for image-to-3D generation.
NTYGJJSxHv.problem: Rendered-image rewards miss geometric quality, while explicit 3D supervision is ambiguous for regions unseen in a single input image.
NTYGJJSxHv.method: Hybrid3D-RL trains an implicit latent reward model from multi-granularity VAE re-encoding preference pairs using a pretrained generator's geometry prior. HRPO combines that reward with camera-corrected appearance rewards and optimizes stochastic flow trajectories using relative advantages and reference-policy regularization.
NTYGJJSxHv.key_idea: Combine a VAE-preference-trained latent geometry reward with camera-corrected rendering rewards to optimize stochastic flow trajectories.
NTYGJJSxHv.evidence: Quantitative and qualitative experiments assess latent quality discrimination and image-to-3D generation in a VoxSet-based framework.

6lBNTLNwNe.one_liner: Phase-aligned spatial supervision and teacher action-preference distillation train navigation policies without explicit spatial reasoning at inference.
6lBNTLNwNe.problem: Strong spatial-reasoning benchmark performance does not necessarily transfer to downstream navigation.
6lBNTLNwNe.method: The approach builds Spatial-Nav-100K and trains a shared spatial-navigation foundation before phase-specific specialization. Spatial-NPD distills grounded action preferences from a teacher conditioned on spatial priors into a student navigation policy.
6lBNTLNwNe.key_idea: Align spatial training with navigation phases and distill spatial-prior-conditioned teacher action preferences into the navigation policy.
6lBNTLNwNe.evidence: An 8B model undergoes 45 A100 GPU-hours of policy training and is evaluated on HM3D-v0.2, HM3D-v0.1, and train-unseen MP3D.
6lBNTLNwNe.claimed_gains: The model reaches SR/SPL of 77.4/35.4 on HM3D-v0.2, 60.2/30.5 on HM3D-v0.1, and 47.9/20.6 on train-unseen MP3D at 148 ms per action step.

FhkR2SEwBZ.one_liner: Dirichlet-categorical augmentation adds simplex-valued states while preserving uniform discrete diffusion's categorical corruption process.
FhkR2SEwBZ.problem: Adding continuous states to uniform discrete diffusion requires preserving its categorical corruption process and defining tractable reverse prediction.
FhkR2SEwBZ.method: Simplax couples corrupted categorical states with auxiliary simplex-valued variables through an exact Dirichlet-categorical augmentation. It derives a Rao-Blackwellized reverse-bridge objective and stochastic reverse sampler while retaining categorical states as denoiser inputs.
FhkR2SEwBZ.key_idea: Attach an auxiliary simplex variable through Dirichlet-categorical augmentation while retaining uniform categorical marginals and categorical denoiser inputs.
FhkR2SEwBZ.evidence: Experiments assess perplexity-entropy tradeoffs on unconditional OpenWebText generation under matched training budgets and Sudoku generalization after training exclusively on 30-clue puzzles.

4ahMYyFW0q.one_liner: A single generator evaluation broadcasts edited keyframes across a source video conditioned on an instruction and temporal slots.
4ahMYyFW0q.problem: Propagating an image edit through a video often requires an additional costly generation pass.
4ahMYyFW0q.method: EditCast fully fine-tunes VACE-1.3B with pixel and perceptual losses on sampled temporal windows. Given a source clip, edited keyframe, temporal slot, and instruction, it predicts the full edited clip in one generator evaluation.
4ahMYyFW0q.key_idea: Condition a single generator evaluation on source video, edited keyframes and their temporal slots, and an instruction.
4ahMYyFW0q.evidence: Evaluations use KeyEdit-50 at 1280 × 720 with four image editors, a matched 30-step flow-matching editor, propagation baselines, and single-H200 runtime measurements.
4ahMYyFW0q.claimed_gains: EditCast runs at 6.3 FPS or 16.8 FPS with TinyVAE, at least 33 times faster than all 50-step propagation baselines or 87 times with TinyVAE, and preserves 93% of the edit on clips 2.5 times the training length.

ZmCMvyomhA.one_liner: Scientific knowledge graphs generate, select, and score research ideas using auditable structural priors.
ZmCMvyomhA.problem: Black-box judgments and proxy labels make idea evaluators difficult to audit and weakly grounded in implementation outcomes.
ZmCMvyomhA.method: SciGraph decomposes literature into meta, mechanism, and protocol nodes connected by citation, combination, and result-comparison relations. It samples candidate ideas, selects them for execution with two fixed policies, and scores text mapped back to graph nodes using the same priors.
ZmCMvyomhA.key_idea: Map research ideas to literature-derived graph nodes and use shared graph priors for policy-based selection and evaluation.
ZmCMvyomhA.evidence: The pipeline defines mainstream and novelty-oriented candidate-selection policies that differ only in weighting three graph-derived priors and produces the SciGraph-Probe evaluation set.

feSoknGite.one_liner: Image-induced emotion steering carries covert signals through inter-agent messages to activate a downstream knowledge-base item.
feSoknGite.problem: An attacker controlling only an upstream image cannot directly edit downstream messages, and explicit malicious triggers would stand out during inspection.
feSoknGite.method: Emotion-Steering Visual Attack changes the client-side image to induce an emotional expression mode in an upstream VLM, which relays task-consistent messages carrying the signal. A crafted downstream knowledge-base item remains dormant until messages with that signal retrieve it.
feSoknGite.key_idea: Steer upstream emotional expression through image manipulation so downstream messages retrieve a dormant crafted knowledge-base item.

2cGIuD4L2X.one_liner: Rewritable proposal states refine future tokens through lookahead updates before masked diffusion commits them.
2cGIuD4L2X.problem: Masked diffusion offers easier optimization but less computational expressivity than uniform diffusion's iterative state revision.
2cGIuD4L2X.method: LED augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state and performs several lookahead updates before committing tokens to the masked sequence. It fine-tunes Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B into LED-7B and LED-8B.
2cGIuD4L2X.key_idea: Iteratively revise a proposal state through lookahead updates before committing tokens under the masked diffusion transition schedule.
2cGIuD4L2X.evidence: The paper analyzes optimization and expressivity differences between masked and uniform diffusion and evaluates LED-7B and LED-8B across eight benchmarks.
2cGIuD4L2X.claimed_gains: LED SFT yields average gains of +11.4 and +7.7 points over standard MDM SFT for LED-7B and LED-8B, respectively.

KnawR83cnY.one_liner: Decomposes video questions into dynamic visual cues that concurrently probe frames and iteratively revise via VLM reasoning.
KnawR83cnY.problem: Question-conditioned keyframe selection fails when relevant frames lack direct lexical similarity to multi-part or implicit questions, or when static subqueries miss video context.
KnawR83cnY.method: CueKFS is a training-free agentic keyframe selector that decomposes a question from initial salient frames into visual cues, probes the video concurrently per cue, uses a reasoning VLM to revise the cue set against retrieved visual evidence, and allocates the frame budget across surviving cues.
KnawR83cnY.key_idea: Decompose a question from initial salient frames into visual cues that concurrently probe the video, iteratively revise cues with a reasoning VLM, and allocate frame budgets across surviving cues.
KnawR83cnY.evidence: Evaluated across three long-video understanding benchmarks spanning 27 frame-budget and model settings.
KnawR83cnY.claimed_gains: Achieves budget-averaged accuracy gains of up to +4.54% over prior baselines across 27 evaluated benchmark settings.

FTIy3O0kyg.one_liner: Captions long videos clip-by-clip conditioned on a pre-scanned Persistent Identity Gallery and an Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary.
FTIy3O0kyg.problem: Segment-wise captioning of long videos under limited context windows produces inconsistent subject references and fragmented long-range narratives.
FTIy3O0kyg.method: PIGEONS first scans the entire video to build a Persistent Identity Gallery anchoring key subjects and their visual appearances, then generates captions clip-by-clip conditioned on that gallery and an Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary updated after each clip, trained via a three-stage SFT and reinforcement learning pipeline.
FTIy3O0kyg.key_idea: Pre-scan the full video to build a persistent subject identity gallery, then generate clip-by-clip captions conditioned on that gallery and a step-updated narrative summary.
FTIy3O0kyg.evidence: Evaluated on long-video captioning benchmarks measuring caption accuracy, completeness, and narrative coherence.

EUJgcYhv7Q.one_liner: Benchmarks real-world spatial audio-visual grounding, alignment, and reasoning with prerequisite-linked diagnostics and an evidence-augmented baseline.
EUJgcYhv7Q.problem: Existing spatial audio-visual benchmarks rely heavily on simulated scenes, test isolated skills, and fail to diagnose whether reasoning errors stem from prerequisite grounding or cross-modal alignment failures.
EUJgcYhv7Q.method: The paper introduces SAVU-Bench spanning three capability levels and seven real-world spatial audio-visual tasks, paired with SAVU-Diag, which decomposes reasoning questions into scene-linked grounding and alignment prerequisites. It also proposes SAVU-EA, a training-free evidence-augmented baseline that surfaces explicit spatial cues.
EUJgcYhv7Q.key_idea: Pair seven real-world spatial audio-visual tasks with scene-linked prerequisite grounding/alignment diagnostics and a training-free evidence-augmented baseline that surfaces explicit spatial cues.
EUJgcYhv7Q.evidence: Evaluates 19 representative audio-visual and multimodal models alongside SAVU-EA across SAVU-Bench and SAVU-Diag.

cXoEBG220E.one_liner: Extracts hierarchical codebook prototypes from relational chains into a transferable structural grammar for knowledge graph reasoning.
cXoEBG220E.problem: Knowledge graph foundation models encode transferable relational patterns implicitly inside dense representations, making structural patterns difficult to organize and reuse explicitly across unseen KGs.
cXoEBG220E.method: ChainGram uses a hierarchical codebook encoder over relational chains to learn word-level structural codes and chain-level prototypes organized into a relation-specific structural grammar. A grammar-guided reasoner then selects query-relevant chain patterns and aggregates pattern-consistent evidence for entity prediction.
cXoEBG220E.key_idea: Encode relational chains via a hierarchical codebook into word-level codes and chain-level prototypes organized as a relation-specific grammar for query-conditioned entity prediction.
cXoEBG220E.evidence: Evaluated across 54 knowledge graphs spanning six zero-shot and supervised evaluation settings.
cXoEBG220E.claimed_gains: Improves overall MRR over the strongest baseline across 54 knowledge graphs by 2.82% under zero-shot inference and 5.84% in the full setting.

YN52V8CKh3.one_liner: Fine-tunes an image tokenizer decoder on interpolated code mixtures using adversarial naturalness and mixing-ratio preservation losses.
YN52V8CKh3.problem: Latent diffusion generators produce codes lying between training-image codes rather than noisy versions of single codes, causing standard noise-augmented tokenizer decoders to render artifacts.
YN52V8CKh3.method: InterpTok fine-tunes the MAETok decoder directly on convex mixtures of pairs of training-image codes. Because ground-truth pixel targets do not exist for code mixtures, training combines a discriminator requiring decoded mixtures to look as natural as source images with a mixing-ratio loss enforcing preservation of the interpolation weights.
YN52V8CKh3.key_idea: Train the tokenizer decoder on mixtures of training-image codes regularized by a naturalness discriminator and a code-mixing-ratio preservation loss.
YN52V8CKh3.evidence: Evaluated on reconstruction quality, a recent latent-interpolation benchmark, and downstream latent diffusion image generation against MAETok and competing tokenizers.
YN52V8CKh3.claimed_gains: Preserves MAETok reconstruction quality while improving interpolation quality more than threefold, lowering downstream generation FID by more than a quarter, and matching MAETok generation quality at half the generator training.

guKIzN8LaX.one_liner: Geometrically initialized Wasserstein Procrustes aligns disjoint unimodal embedding spaces via an orthogonal map without paired examples.
guKIzN8LaX.problem: Aligning independently trained representations across modalities typically requires large paired datasets despite underlying structural similarity across unimodal embedding spaces.
guKIzN8LaX.method: GeoWarP combines a coarse geometric initialization with Wasserstein Procrustes optimization to estimate a single orthogonal transformation between two disjoint sets of embeddings using zero or very few paired examples. Standard geometric alignment metrics are also used to predict when unpaired alignment succeeds.
guKIzN8LaX.key_idea: Estimate an orthogonal cross-modal mapping between unpaired embedding distributions using Wasserstein Procrustes initialized from coarse intrinsic geometry.
guKIzN8LaX.evidence: Evaluated across datasets, modalities, and independently trained unimodal models in zero-pair and few-pair regimes, including unpaired text-to-image generation.

AfJJPX455e.one_liner: Continuum gradient-flow analysis shows per-task training time in gradual adaptation should scale inversely with task sampling frequency.
AfJJPX455e.problem: In gradual continual adaptation, it is unclear how per-task training duration should scale when intermediate tasks are sampled more frequently along a smooth transition.
AfJJPX455e.method: The paper analyzes gradient-flow training across N smoothly varying overparameterized linear regression tasks and extends the scaling analysis to smooth nonlinear networks under nonsingular transitions. It derives a continuum limit where per-task training time scales as τ/N for a constant total training budget τ.
AfJJPX455e.key_idea: Keep total training time constant by scaling per-task training time as τ_⋆/N as the number of intermediate tasks N increases along a transition.
AfJJPX455e.evidence: Supported by asymptotic learning-progress theorems (Θ(τ) at small τ, Θ(τ⁻¹) at large τ, and o(1/N) optimality gap) and experiments on Rotated MNIST and Rotated Fashion-MNIST across models, losses, and metrics.
AfJJPX455e.claimed_gains: Training for τ_⋆/N per task achieves learning progress within o(1/N) of the maximum over all per-task training schedules on smoothly varying overparameterized linear regression.

YBpRwXl1Lg.one_liner: Gaussian mixture reliability weights calibrate Bayesian label transition matrices to train recommenders on noisy implicit feedback without discarding data.
YBpRwXl1Lg.problem: Implicit-feedback recommenders either discard noisy interactions at the cost of data efficiency or estimate Bayesian label transition matrices that become skewed when distilled labels are unreliable.
YBpRwXl1Lg.method: Robust GMM-weighted Bayesian Label Transition Matrix (RGBT) fits a Gaussian Mixture Model to assign per-instance reliability scores and uses those weights to calibrate Bayesian transition matrix estimation while retaining all training samples. Theoretical analysis establishes consistency on the reliable subset and variance reduction under a weight domination condition.
YBpRwXl1Lg.key_idea: Weight Bayesian label transition matrix estimation by GMM-derived instance reliability scores so noisy implicit feedback is calibrated without dropping samples.
YBpRwXl1Lg.evidence: Supported by consistency and variance-reduction proofs relative to Clean Label Transition Matrix estimators and experiments on synthetic and real-world recommendation datasets.

l1fGdveTJc.one_liner: Graph-operator identifiability modulus and sparse field-repair algorithms characterize when corrupted black-box LLM responses are recoverable.
l1fGdveTJc.problem: Consistency-based voting and revision methods cannot determine whether a set of black-box LLM responses is recoverable or detect shared hallucinations lying in relation null spaces.
l1fGdveTJc.method: Queries under typed symmetries (paraphrase, scaling, decomposition, refactoring) and trusted verifier anchors are modeled as a Relational Response Field with relation operator D and anchor operator A. Using an identifiability modulus γ_k(D,A) over at most k corrupted nodes, the paper derives minimax stability bounds and sparse field-repair algorithms.
l1fGdveTJc.key_idea: Model symmetry-linked LLM outputs and verifier anchors as a relational field whose operator modulus γ_k(D,A) governs k-corruption identifiability and sparse recovery.
l1fGdveTJc.evidence: Supported by deterministic stability and matching two-point minimax lower bounds, controlled theorem tests, and black-box mathematics and code experiments.

FTnKsaOKH0.one_liner: Asynchronous dual-system world action model couples periodic high-noise global trajectory denoising with fast wrist-guided low-noise local refinement.
FTnKsaOKH0.problem: World Action Models rely on long action chunks to amortize costly future visual prediction, sacrificing high-frequency closed-loop responsiveness during contact-rich manipulation.
FTnKsaOKH0.method: DualWAM runs two asynchronous systems along a shared denoising trajectory: System 2 periodically performs high-noise bidirectional denoising over a broad world-action horizon, while wrist-only System 1 extracts short aligned windows from intermediate denoising states and completes low-noise refinement using fresh wrist-camera observations.
FTnKsaOKH0.key_idea: Share an intermediate denoising trajectory asynchronously between slow broad-horizon global planning and fast wrist-conditioned low-noise local action refinement.
FTnKsaOKH0.evidence: Evaluated on zero-shot robotic manipulation tasks across Franka and Galbot platforms.
FTnKsaOKH0.claimed_gains: DualWAM improves average zero-shot manipulation success by 4.5 percentage points over the strongest evaluated baseline while achieving a 16.6× critical-path speedup.

UPgcRmpGm9.one_liner: Dimensionless residual flow-matching prior over harmonic mesh extensions combines with test-time observable scale estimation for cross-family motion completion.
UPgcRmpGm9.problem: Learned residual priors for sparse-to-dense 3D mesh motion completion fail across geometry families because residual amplitude varies by orders of magnitude across shapes and observation densities.
UPgcRmpGm9.method: Cepheid decomposes dense 3D mesh motion into a parameter-free harmonic base extension plus a dimensionless structural residual prior, decoupling normalized deformation shape from physical amplitude. At test time, physical scale is estimated from sparse vertex observables and mesh structure with a lightweight source-fitted correction.
UPgcRmpGm9.key_idea: Learn a normalized dimensionless residual prior over parameter-free harmonic mesh extensions and recover physical amplitude at test time from sparse observables.
UPgcRmpGm9.evidence: Evaluated across multiple 3D geometry families including unseen cloth, legged bodies, point-tracked animal video, and soft-body robotic grasping without skeletons or mesh registration.

okuZ5MCeuT.one_liner: Temporary matrix product operator factorizations overparameterize LLM post-training updates before contracting back into unchanged deployment weights or LoRA ranks.
okuZ5MCeuT.problem: Local deployment constrains model size and adapter rank, limiting the optimization parameterization available during language model post-training.
okuZ5MCeuT.method: MPO-PRO parameterizes dense updates or fixed-rank LoRA factors as temporary matrix product operators (MPOs) during post-training, approximately matching first-order LoRA-Pro reference updates in the fixed-rank branch. Before deployment, the MPO factors are contracted back into the original dense weights or fixed-rank adapter without inference overhead.
okuZ5MCeuT.key_idea: Express dense or LoRA weight updates in temporary matrix product operator coordinates during training and contract them back before deployment.
okuZ5MCeuT.evidence: Evaluated on GSM8K, HumanEval, and SciBench Physics (after SciInstruct training) against full fine-tuning and LoRA-Pro, alongside update-decomposition analyses.

r6Zoz6Luqp.one_liner: Copula-coupled marginal covariate forecasts generate joint exogenous scenarios whose mixture modulates probabilistic target time-series predictions.
r6Zoz6Luqp.problem: Time-series forecasters with exogenous variables treat future covariates either as single deterministic trajectories or fixed context, ignoring joint uncertainty across unknown future covariates.
r6Zoz6Luqp.method: MarCO forecasts the marginal distributions of future exogenous covariates from historical inputs, couples them into a joint distribution via a copula, and samples coherent multi-covariate future scenarios. Each drawn scenario modulates a conditional target forecast, and the final prediction is formed as the mixture across scenarios.
r6Zoz6Luqp.key_idea: Couple marginal future covariate forecasts with a copula to sample joint exogenous scenarios and form the target forecast as a scenario-modulated mixture.
r6Zoz6Luqp.evidence: Evaluated using historical inputs only across 12 real-world time-series forecasting datasets against deterministic and probabilistic baselines.
r6Zoz6Luqp.claimed_gains: MarCO ranks first in MSE on 11 of 12 real-world datasets and reduces average MSE by 5.2% and 5.9% relative to deterministic and probabilistic baselines.

pAAmSO4iVe.one_liner: Dual VLMs generate step-local dense rewards and verify step completion to switch active reward functions during robot policy learning.
pAAmSO4iVe.problem: Global scalar visual progress rewards rely on demonstration frame positions that conflate task progress with elapsed time and poorly supervise stagnation, regression, and recovery.
pAAmSO4iVe.method: RoboStep decomposes manipulation tasks with a Frame-VLM that synthesizes step-local dense reward functions, while an online Gate-VLM verifies step completion from visual observations to advance and switch the active reward function. Combined with real-to-sim scene reconstruction pipelines, policies trained with these structured rewards in simulation transfer back to real-world scenes.
pAAmSO4iVe.key_idea: Decompose tasks into step-local dense rewards with a Frame-VLM and switch active reward stages online using a Gate-VLM step-completion verifier.
pAAmSO4iVe.evidence: Evaluated in simulated robotic manipulation experiments comparing step-verification versus global scalar VLM rewards under matched policy-learning settings, plus real-to-sim-to-real transfer.

BrrM1HlZaC.one_liner: Converts recovered reproduction procedures into refined code, launchers, environments, and guides for coding agents.
BrrM1HlZaC.problem: ML reproduction requires agents to reconstruct scattered procedures and missing decisions rather than simply execute released artifacts.
BrrM1HlZaC.method: ReproBridge builds standardized artifacts containing a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide. ReproBridge-Bench compares fresh-session agents using raw or refined artifacts, with an Auditor separately checking execution evidence.
BrrM1HlZaC.key_idea: Preserve recovered experimental procedures and their rationale in a standardized reusable artifact that later agents can execute independently.
BrrM1HlZaC.evidence: The benchmark contains 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, each anchored by five human-verified reference scores, with four models and component ablations.
BrrM1HlZaC.claimed_gains: Refined artifacts increase mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average.

gll8jlEkbo.one_liner: Assigns token-level RL credit asymmetrically using policy entropy to reinforce surprising successes and penalize confident failures.
gll8jlEkbo.problem: Uniform entropy prioritization can penalize uncertain failed positions where alternatives remain, suppressing exploration and recovery opportunities.
gll8jlEkbo.method: EAPO combines normalized policy entropy with response-advantage sign to redistribute outcome advantages across tokens. It reinforces high-entropy successful decisions, penalizes low-entropy failed decisions, and attenuates penalties at uncertain failed positions without additional supervision.
gll8jlEkbo.key_idea: Interact token entropy with outcome sign so successful uncertainty receives stronger reinforcement while confident failures receive stronger penalties.
gll8jlEkbo.evidence: The method derives token credit directly from existing rollout signals, but the provided abstract does not state experimental datasets or results.

C1k1JBdsI3.one_liner: Decomposes GUI trajectories into verified milestones for calibrated reward verdicts and fine-grained online-RL credit.
C1k1JBdsI3.problem: GUI-agent reinforcement learning needs reward signals that are both scalable and accurate in stochastic environments.
C1k1JBdsI3.method: OS-Themis uses a multi-agent critic to isolate evidence by verifiable milestones and audit the evidence chain before producing a verdict. MC-GRPO then assigns intra-trajectory credit from those milestones, supported by the multi-platform OGRBench reward benchmark.
C1k1JBdsI3.key_idea: Turn GUI trajectories into independently verifiable milestones whose audited evidence supports both outcome rewards and token-level group-relative credit.
C1k1JBdsI3.evidence: Experiments evaluate reward quality across models on OGRBench and online RL on AndroidWorld, including scaling to 1,024 training tasks.
C1k1JBdsI3.claimed_gains: OS-Themis with MC-GRPO improves AndroidWorld by up to 9.4%, MC-GRPO adds 2.5–2.9% over standard GRPO, and scaling to 1,024 tasks yields a 10.7% improvement.

0GqmXKjivq.one_liner: Distills rich LLM object and scene descriptions into a real-time DETR open-vocabulary detector via Dual-Path Description Alignment.
0GqmXKjivq.problem: Compact real-time open-vocabulary detectors struggle to absorb rich instance attributes, actions, and scene context under strict inference budgets.
0GqmXKjivq.method: RT-DETR-World builds GroundingCapv2 with category, object-description, and image-description supervision, and uses Dual-Path Description Alignment pairing a deployment-consistent MiniLM path with an offline LLM teacher.
0GqmXKjivq.key_idea: Aligns a compact DETR detector with both MiniLM and offline LLM teacher description features during training while keeping lightweight query-text matching at inference.

1dSWdulatT.one_liner: Processes source video and interleaved text, image, and video references in a single-stream DiT using R2-RoPE.
1dSWdulatT.problem: Video editing models lack a unified mechanism to combine arbitrary numbers of text, image, and video references for multi-attribute control.
1dSWdulatT.method: OmniXRef introduces a reference-bank interface with R2-RoPE, a single-stream diffusion transformer over interleaved MLLM context, curriculum-trained synthetic data (OmniXRef-Data), and OmniXRef-Bench.
1dSWdulatT.key_idea: Interleaves source video and MLLM-encoded text, image, and video references in a single-stream diffusion transformer with R2-RoPE.
1dSWdulatT.evidence: Evaluations on the constructed OmniXRef-Bench covering Camera, Motion, Content, Style, and VFX with one to five references.

CVJinWDrCM.one_liner: Trains an end-to-end agentic factuality verifier to group claims, route search, and reuse evidence via privileged-teacher SFT and DPO.
CVJinWDrCM.problem: Static decompose-search-verify pipelines process claims independently, scaling LLM and search calls linearly and repeating overlapping searches.
CVJinWDrCM.method: EAVer learns a unified policy that groups related claims, routes groups to direct verification or search, and caches evidence in in-context memos, trained on 1,447 teacher trajectories and 794 same-trajectory DPO pairs.
CVJinWDrCM.key_idea: Replaces static claim-by-claim pipelines with a single agentic policy trained via privileged-teacher trajectories and decision-focused DPO to group claims and reuse search memos.
CVJinWDrCM.evidence: Experiments with Qwen3-8B against search-based factuality verification baselines.
CVJinWDrCM.claimed_gains: With Qwen3-8B, outperforms the strongest search-based baseline on each benchmark by 2.88 Macro-F1 points (remaining benchmark numbers truncated in abstract).

ZBZ2HrVqeq.one_liner: Calibrates test-time prompt tuning by temperature scaling toward zero-shot confidence, optionally paired with a weak-strong augmentation ensemble.
ZBZ2HrVqeq.problem: Test-time prompt tuning improves accuracy on single test instances but degrades calibration, while prior dispersion regularizers hurt accuracy.
ZBZ2HrVqeq.method: CoTS applies post-hoc temperature scaling to align adapted confidence with well-calibrated zero-shot predictions, and E-CoTS applies CoTS on top of a weak-strong augmentation ensemble.
ZBZ2HrVqeq.key_idea: Matches adapted TPT prediction confidence to zero-shot prediction confidence via post-hoc temperature scaling without altering accuracy.
ZBZ2HrVqeq.evidence: Experiments across ImageNet variants, diverse datasets, and multiple backbones, including integration with existing calibration methods.
ZBZ2HrVqeq.claimed_gains: E-CoTS reduces average expected calibration error of TPT from 11.90% to 5.38% on ImageNet variants while increasing accuracy from 60.74% to 62.95%.

f7p5NRwcKR.one_liner: Disentangles semantic and structural graph channels via dual-gradient masking and preserves them with client generative replay and server distillation.
f7p5NRwcKR.problem: Federated continual graph learning suffers from coupled semantic and structural catastrophic forgetting across decentralized, non-shared client graphs.
f7p5NRwcKR.method: FedDiG derives complementary semantic and structural channels using post-hoc dual-gradient feature masking, trains a client-side generator on current local graphs, and performs server-side dual-channel distillation.
f7p5NRwcKR.key_idea: Separates node semantics from structural topology via dual-gradient feature masking and aligns both channels through client generative replay and server distillation.
f7p5NRwcKR.evidence: Experiments across seven graph datasets in federated continual learning settings.

mTFXwUXMNR.one_liner: Provides FinFraudBench, two large heterogeneous graph benchmarks preserving multi-entity payment structure and extreme class imbalance.
mTFXwUXMNR.problem: Public graph fraud-detection benchmarks oversimplify payment ecosystems into homogeneous graphs and lack support for extreme class imbalance and limited labels.
mTFXwUXMNR.method: The authors construct FinFraudBench from two public synthetic datasets (CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud), preserving six financial entity types, fourteen directed edge types, and source fraud prevalence, alongside a standardized ranking and imbalance-sensitive evaluation protocol.
mTFXwUXMNR.key_idea: Preserving six entity types, fourteen directed edge types, and true fraud prevalence in large synthetic payment graphs enables realistic heterogeneous fraud benchmarking.
mTFXwUXMNR.evidence: Benchmarking representative baselines on CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud (up to 8.99M nodes and 89.23M directed typed edges).

iVmTuFjFZ8.one_liner: Benchmarks multimodal agents on 133 long-horizon cooking tasks with physical dynamics, 176 interactive objects, and structured observations.
iVmTuFjFZ8.problem: Whether multimodal agents' digital capabilities transfer to long-horizon, physically grounded embodied planning tasks remains unclear.
iVmTuFjFZ8.method: CookBench provides an interactive cooking environment with 133 single-dish tasks averaging over 130 steps, 176 objects, and physical dynamics, evaluated via a standardized Embodied Planning Machine harness.
iVmTuFjFZ8.key_idea: Tests multimodal agents on 130+ step cooking tasks with physical dynamics and large action spaces using structured text and optional RGB observations.
iVmTuFjFZ8.evidence: Systematic evaluation of representative agent frameworks and frontier VLMs compared against human operators on 133 tasks.
iVmTuFjFZ8.claimed_gains: GPT-5.4-driven agents reach a dish-quality score of 8.35 out of 100, compared to about 93 for human operators.

NuDvqRckHl.one_liner: Proves an algorithmic separation where log-depth networks learn hierarchical Boolean functions that constant-depth networks cannot approximate.
NuDvqRckHl.problem: Theoretical depth separations mostly address approximation power or two- versus three-layer networks rather than algorithmic learnability at logarithmic depth.
NuDvqRckHl.method: The authors identify a class of Boolean functions with hierarchically structured Fourier spectra and prove that logarithmic-depth networks trained via layerwise coordinate descent learn them efficiently, while polynomial-width constant-depth regular networks incur constant L2 error.
NuDvqRckHl.key_idea: Shows layerwise coordinate descent in log-depth networks adaptively reconstructs hierarchical Fourier spectra that constant-depth networks fail to approximate.
NuDvqRckHl.evidence: Theoretical proofs establishing efficient learnability for log-depth networks and L2 approximation lower bounds for constant-depth networks.

Vz5HYpFSDO.one_liner: Provides an interactive MIMIC-IV environment with Clean-Noise pairs to benchmark and train clinical EHR agents.
Vz5HYpFSDO.problem: Clinical agents often overlook discrepancies or missing evidence in noisy electronic health records and return plausible but unsupported answers.
Vz5HYpFSDO.method: EHR-RobustGym builds 5,486 Clean-Noise query pairs across six clinical intents on MIMIC-IV with interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification for evaluation and RL/SFT training.
Vz5HYpFSDO.key_idea: Pairs clean and noisy MIMIC-IV clinical queries across record, value, and query noise levels inside an executable SQL/Python agent environment.
Vz5HYpFSDO.evidence: Benchmarks proprietary and open-weight LLMs on EHR-RobustGym and tests SFT and RL transfer across five external EHR benchmarks.
Vz5HYpFSDO.claimed_gains: Average task success across evaluated models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions, with pass^k consistency at k=4 falling below 50% for most models.

XDBQq1HsHq.one_liner: Predicts calibrated KV-cache token budgets from prefill hidden states by modeling both expected length and variance.
XDBQq1HsHq.problem: Disaggregated LLM serving struggles to reserve KV-cache capacity because repeated generations from the same prompt vary widely in output length.
XDBQq1HsHq.method: RACE trains two predictors on prefill hidden states and multiple sampled responses to estimate typical length and variability, assigns larger margins to high-variance prompts, and calibrates margins on a held-out set.
XDBQq1HsHq.key_idea: Scales KV-cache safety margins by predicted response-length variability from prefill states and calibrates them on an independent prompt set.
XDBQq1HsHq.evidence: Experiments on Qwen3-8B and DeepScaleR compared against a calibrated quantile-regression baseline (GBM-Quantile-PAC).
XDBQq1HsHq.claimed_gains: On Qwen3-8B and DeepScaleR, RACE reduces the average token budget by 9.94% compared with GBM-Quantile-PAC while accommodating 97.56% of test outputs.

zUMxdtC1fA.one_liner: Organizes VideoQA into object-anchored perception, reasoning, and summarization groups built by an agentic verification loop.
zUMxdtC1fA.problem: Existing VideoQA benchmarks evaluate independent QA pairs on different objects, obscuring whether models succeed consistently on the same object.
zUMxdtC1fA.method: AnchorGroup groups perception, reasoning, and summarization questions around shared objects, constructed via A^3Loop, an agentic loop that generates questions top-down from clips and refines them using verifier feedback.
zUMxdtC1fA.key_idea: Anchors perception, reasoning, and summarization VideoQA tasks to the same object via an agentic generation-and-verification annotation loop.
zUMxdtC1fA.evidence: Evaluations of Multimodal LLMs on AnchorGroup comparing task-level performance across shared object anchors.

yjKUCmJ9LC.one_liner: Maintains streaming video stylization consistency over long rollouts via source-indexed residual memory, replay regularization, and early-anchored distribution matching.
yjKUCmJ9LC.problem: Streaming video stylization models suffer global style drift and inconsistent restyling of previously seen content after it leaves the active context window.
yjKUCmJ9LC.method: EverStyle stores source-indexed stylization residuals in a memory module (SISM), trains with Replay-Based Stylization Consistency Regularization (RSCR), and aligns current and early style distributions via Early-Anchored Stylization Distribution Matching (EA-SDM).
yjKUCmJ9LC.key_idea: Combines source-indexed stylization residual memory, replay consistency regularization, and early-anchored style distribution matching to prevent long-horizon drift.

wODuGIZFpv.one_liner: Decomposes transformer KV caches into reusable object-centric semantic slots for streaming long-video generation.
